kjv: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

wlc: כִּי־אֱמֶת יֶהְגֶּה חִכִּי וְתוֹעֲבַת שְׂפָתַי רֶשַׁע ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἀλήθειαν μελετήσει ὁ φάρυγξ μου, ἐβδελυγμένα δὲ ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ χείλη ψευδῆ·
vulg: veritatem meditabitur guttur meum et labia mea detestabuntur impium
clem: Veritatem meditabitur guttur meum, et labia mea detestabuntur impium.
kjv: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

wlc: בְּצֶדֶק כָּל־אִמְרֵי־פִי אֵין בָּהֶם נִפְתָּל וְעִקֵּשׁ ׃
lxx: μετὰ δικαιοσύνης πάντα τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ στόματός μου, οὐδὲν ἐν αὐτοῖς σκολιὸν οὐδὲ στραγγαλῶδες·
vulg: iusti sunt omnes sermones mei non est in eis pravum quid neque perversum
clem: Justi sunt omnes sermones mei: non est in eis pravum quid, neque perversum;
kjv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.

wlc: כֻּלָּם נְכֹחִים לַמֵּבִין וִישָׁרִים לְמֹצְאֵי דָעַת ׃
lxx: πάντα ἐνώπια τοῖς συνιοῦσιν, καὶ ὀρθὰ τοῖς εὑρίσκουσι γνῶσιν.
vulg: recti sunt intellegentibus et aequi invenientibus scientiam
clem: recti sunt intelligentibus, et qui invenientibus scientiam.
kjv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

wlc: קְחוּ־מוּסָרִי וְאַל־כָּסֶף וְדַעַת מֵחָרוּץ נִבְחָר ׃
lxx: λάβετε παιδείαν καὶ μὴ ἀργύριον, καὶ γνῶσιν ὑπέρ χρυσίον δεδοκιμασμένον·
vulg: accipite disciplinam meam et non pecuniam doctrinam magis quam aurum eligite
clem: Accipite disciplinam meam, et non pecuniam; doctrinam magis quam aurum eligite:
kjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

wlc: כִּי־טוֹבָה חָכְמָה מִפְּנִינִים וְכָל־חֲפָצִים לֹא יִשְׁווּ־בָהּ ׃
lxx: κρείσσων γὰρ σοφία λίθων πολυτελῶν, ᾶν δὲ τίμιον οὐκ ἄξιον αὐτῆς ἐστιν.
vulg: melior est enim sapientia cunctis pretiosissimis et omne desiderabile ei non potest conparari
clem: melior est enim sapientia cunctis pretiosissimis, et omne desiderabile ei non potest comparari.]
kjv: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

wlc: אֲנִי־חָכְמָה שָׁכַנְתִּי עָרְמָה וְדַעַת מְזִמּוֹת אֶמְצָא ׃
lxx: ἐγὼ ἡ σοφία κατεσκήνωσα βουλήν, καὶ γνῶσιν καὶ ἔννοιαν ἐγὼ ἐπεκαλεσάμην· κρείσσων γὰρ σοφία λίθων πολυτελῶν.
vulg: ego sapientia habito in consilio et eruditis intersum cogitationibus
clem: [Ego sapientia, habito in consilio, et eruditis intersum cogitationibus.
kjv: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

wlc: יִרְאַת יְהוָה שְׂנֹאת רָע גֵּאָה וְגָאוֹן וְדֶרֶךְ רָע וּפִי תַהְפֻּכוֹת שָׂנֵאתִי ׃
lxx: φόβος Κυρίου μισεῖ ἀδικίαν, ὕβριν τε καὶ ὑπερηφανίαν καὶ ὁδοὺς πονηρῶν· μεμίσηκα δὲ ἐγὼ διεστραμμένας ὁδοὺς κακῶν.
vulg: timor Domini odit malum arrogantiam et superbiam et viam pravam et os bilingue detestor
clem: Timor Domini odit malum: arrogantiam, et superbiam, et viam pravam, et os bilingue, detestor.
kjv: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

wlc: לִי־עֵצָה וְתוּשִׁיָּה אֲנִי בִינָה לִי גְבוּרָה ׃
lxx: ἐμὴ βουλὴ καὶ ἀσφάλεια, ἐμὴ φρόνησις. ἐμὴ δὲ ἰσχύς·
vulg: meum est consilium et aequitas mea prudentia mea est fortitudo
clem: Meum est consilium et quitas; mea est prudentia, mea est fortitudo.
kjv: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

wlc: בִּי מְלָכִים יִמְלֹכוּ וְרוֹזְנִים יְחֹקְקוּ צֶדֶק ׃
lxx: δἰ ἐμοῦ βασιλεῖς βασιλεύουσιν, καὶ οἱ δυνάσται γράφουσιν δικαιοσύνην·
vulg: per me reges regnant et legum conditores iusta decernunt
clem: Per me reges regnant, et legum conditores justa decernunt;
kjv: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

wlc: בִּי שָׂרִים יָשֹׂרוּ וּנְדִיבִים כָּל־שֹׁפְטֵי צֶדֶק ׃
lxx: εἰ ἐμοῦ μεγιστᾶνες μεγαλύνονται, καὶ τύραννοι δἰ ἐμοῦ κρατοῦσι γῆς
vulg: per me principes imperant et potentes decernunt iustitiam
clem: per me principes imperant, et potentes decernunt justitiam.
kjv: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

wlc: אֲנִי אֹהֲבֶיהָ אֵהָב וּמְשַׁחֲרַי יִמְצָאֻנְנִי ׃
lxx: ἐγὼ τοὺς ἐμὲ φιλοῦντας ἀγαπῶ, οἱ δὲ ἐμέ ζητοῦντες εὑρήσουσιν.
vulg: ego diligentes me diligo et qui mane vigilant ad me invenient me
clem: Ego diligentes me diligo, et qui mane vigilant ad me, invenient me.
kjv: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

wlc: עֹשֶׁר־וְכָבוֹד אִתִּי הוֹן עָתֵק וּצְדָקָה ׃
lxx: πλοῦτος καὶ δόξα ἐμοὶ ὑπάρχει, καὶ κτῆσις πολλῶν καὶ δικαιοσύνη.
vulg: mecum sunt divitiae et gloria opes superbae et iustitia
clem: Mecum sunt diviti et gloria, opes superb et justitia.
kjv: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

wlc: טוֹב פִּרְיִי מֵחָרוּץ וּמִפָּז וּתְבוּאָתִי מִכֶּסֶף נִבְחָר ׃
lxx: βέλτιον ἐμέ καρπίζεσθαι ὑπέρ χρυσίον καὶ λίθον τίμιον. τὰ δὲ ἐμὰ γενήματα κρείσσω ἀργυρίου ἐκλεκτοῦ.
vulg: melior est fructus meus auro et pretioso lapide et genimina mea argento electo
clem: Melior est enim fructus meus auro et lapide pretioso, et genimina me argento electo.
kjv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

wlc: בְּאֹרַח־צְדָקָה אֲהַלֵּך בְּתוֹךְ נְתִיבוֹת מִשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: ἐν ὁδοῖς δικαιοσύνης περιπατῶ, καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τρίβων δικαιώματος ἀναστρέφομαι,
vulg: in viis iustitiae ambulo in medio semitarum iudicii
clem: In viis justiti ambulo, in medio semitarum judicii:
kjv: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

wlc: לְהַנְחִיל אֹהֲבַי יֵשׁ וְאֹצְרֹתֵיהֶם אֲמַלֵּא ׃ פ
lxx: ἵνα μερίσω τοῖς ἐμέ ἀγαπῶσιν ὕπαρξιν, καὶ τοὺς θησαυροὺς αὐτῶν ἐμπλήσω ἀγαθῶν.
vulg: ut ditem diligentes me et thesauros eorum repleam
clem: ut ditem diligentes me, et thesauros eorum repleam.]
kjv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

wlc: יְהוָה קָנָנִי רֵאשִׁית דַּרְכּוֹ קֶדֶם מִפְעָלָיו מֵאָז ׃
lxx: Κύριος ἔκτισέν με ἀρχὴν ὁδῶν αὐτοῦ εἰς ἔργα αὐτοῦ,
vulg: Dominus possedit me initium viarum suarum antequam quicquam faceret a principio
clem: [Dominus possedit me in initio viarum suarum antequam quidquam faceret a principio.
kjv: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

wlc: מֵעוֹלָם נִסַּכְתִּי מֵרֹאשׁ מִקַּדְמֵי־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: πρὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος ἐθεμελίωσέν με ἐν ἀρχῇ,
vulg: ab aeterno ordita sum et ex antiquis antequam terra fieret
clem: Ab terno ordinata sum, et ex antiquis antequam terra fieret.
kjv: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

wlc: בְּאֵין־תְּהֹמוֹת חוֹלָלְתִּי בְּאֵין מַעְיָנוֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־מָיִם ׃
lxx: πρὸ τοῦ τὴν γῆν ποιῆσαι καὶ πρὸ τοῦ τὰς ἀβύσσους ποιῆσαι, πρὸ τοῦ προελθεῖν τὰς πηγὰς τῶν ὑδάτων,
vulg: necdum erant abyssi et ego iam concepta eram necdum fontes aquarum eruperant
clem: Nondum erant abyssi, et ego jam concepta eram: necdum fontes aquarum eruperant,
kjv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

wlc: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים הָטְבָּעוּ לִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת חוֹלָלְתִּי ׃
lxx: πρὸ τοῦ ὄρη ἑδρασθῆναι, πρὸ δέ πάντων βουνῶν γεννᾶ με.
vulg: necdum montes gravi mole constiterant ante colles ego parturiebar
clem: necdum montes gravi mole constiterant: ante colles ego parturiebar.
kjv: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

wlc: עַד־לֹא עָשָׂה אֶרֶץ וְחוּצוֹת וְרֹאשׁ עָפְרוֹת תֵּבֵל ׃
lxx: Κύριος ἐποίησεν χώρας καὶ ἀοικήτους καὶ ἄκρα οἰκούμενα τῆς ὑπʼ οὐρανῶν.
vulg: adhuc terram non fecerat et flumina et cardines orbis terrae
clem: Adhuc terram non fecerat, et flumina, et cardines orbis terr.
kjv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

wlc: בַּהֲכִינוֹ שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָנִי בְּחוּקוֹ חוּג עַל־פְּנֵי תְהוֹם ׃
lxx: ἡνίκα ἡτοίμαζεν τὸν οὐρανόν, συνπαρήμην αὐτῴ, καὶ ὅτε ἀφώριζεν τὸν ἑαυτοῦ θρόνον ἐπʼ ἀνέμων·
vulg: quando praeparabat caelos aderam quando certa lege et gyro vallabat abyssos
clem: Quando prparabat clos, aderam; quando certa lege et gyro vallabat abyssos;
kjv: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

wlc: בְּאַמְּצוֹ שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל בַּעֲזוֹז עִינוֹת תְּהוֹם ׃
lxx: καὶ ὡς ἰσχυρὰ ἐποίει τὰ ἄνω νέφη, καὶ ὡς ἀσφαλεῖς ἐτίθει πηγὰς τῆς ὑπʼ οὐρανόν,
vulg: quando aethera firmabat sursum et librabat fontes aquarum
clem: quando thera firmabat sursum, et librabat fontes aquarum;
kjv: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

wlc: בְּשׂוּמוֹ לַיָּם חֻקּוֹ וּמַיִם לֹא יַעַבְרוּ־פִיו בְּחוּקוֹ מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: καὶ ὡς ἰσχυρὰ ἐποίει τὰ θεμέλια τῆς γῆς,
vulg: quando circumdabat mari terminum suum et legem ponebat aquis ne transirent fines suos quando adpendebat fundamenta terrae
clem: quando circumdabat mari terminum suum, et legem ponebat aquis, ne transirent fines suos; quando appendebat fundamenta terr:
kjv: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

wlc: וָאֶהְיֶה אֶצְלוֹ אָמוֹן וָאֶהְיֶה שַׁעֲשֻׁעִים יוֹם יוֹם מְשַׂחֶקֶת לְפָנָיו בְּכָל־עֵת ׃
lxx: ἤμην παρʼ αὐτῷ ἁρμόζουσα· ἐγὼ ἤμην ᾗ προσέχαιρεν. καθʼ ἡμέραν δὲ εὐφραινόμην ἐν προσώπῳ αὐτοῦ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ,
vulg: cum eo eram cuncta conponens et delectabar per singulos dies ludens coram eo omni tempore
clem: cum eo eram, cuncta componens. Et delectabar per singulos dies, ludens coram eo omni tempore,
kjv: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

wlc: מְשַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵל אַרְצוֹ וְשַׁעֲשֻׁעַי אֶת־בְּנֵי אָדָם ׃ פ
lxx: ὅτε ἐνευφραίνετο τὴν οἰκουμένην συντελέσας, καὶ εὐφραίνετο ἐν υἱοῖς ἀνθρώπων.
vulg: ludens in orbe terrarum et deliciae meae esse cum filiis hominum
clem: ludens in orbe terrarum; et delici me esse cum filiis hominum.
kjv: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

wlc: וְעַתָּה בָנִים שִׁמְעוּ־לִי וְאַשְׁרֵי דְּרָכַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ ׃
lxx: νῦν οὗν, υἱέ, ἄκουέ μου.
vulg: nunc ergo filii audite me beati qui custodiunt vias meas
clem: Nunc ergo, filii, audite me: beati qui custodiunt vias meas.
kjv: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

wlc: שִׁמְעוּ מוּסָר וַחֲכָמוּ וְאַל־תִּפְרָעוּ ׃
vulg: audite disciplinam et estote sapientes et nolite abicere eam
clem: Audite disciplinam, et estote sapientes, et nolite abjicere eam.
kjv: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

wlc: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם שֹׁמֵעַ לִי לִשְׁקֹד עַל־דַּלְתֹתַי יוֹם יוֹם לִשְׁמֹר מְזוּזֹת פְּתָחָי ׃
lxx: μακάριος ἀνὴρ ὃς εἰσακούσεταί μου, καὶ ἄνθρωπος ὃς τὰς ἐμὰς ὁδοὺς φυλάξει. ἀγρυπνῶν ἐπʼ ἐμαῖς θύραις καθʼ ἡμέραν, τηρῶν σταθμοὺς ἐμῶν εἰσόδων.
vulg: beatus homo qui audit me qui vigilat ad fores meas cotidie et observat ad postes ostii mei
clem: Beatus homo qui audit me, et qui vigilat ad fores meas quotidie, et observat ad postes ostii mei.
kjv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

wlc: כִּי מֹצְאִי מֹצְאֵי חַיִּים וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה ׃
lxx: αἱ γὰρ ἔξοδοί μου ἔξοδοι ζωῆς, καὶ ἑτοιμάζεται θέλησις παρὰ Κυρίου.
vulg: qui me invenerit inveniet vitam et hauriet salutem a Domino
clem: Qui me invenerit, inveniet vitam, et hauriet salutem a Domino.
kjv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the Lord.

wlc: וְחֹטְאִי חֹמֵס נַפְשׁוֹ כָּל־מְשַׂנְאַי אָהֲבוּ מָוֶת ׃ פ
lxx: οἱ δὲ εἰς ἐμέ ἁμαρτάνοντες ἀσεβοῦσιν τὰς ἑαυτῶν ψυχάς. καὶ οἱ μισοῦντές με ἀγαπῶσιν θάνατον.
vulg: qui autem in me peccaverit laedet animam suam omnes qui me oderunt diligunt mortem
clem: Qui autem in me peccaverit, ldet animam suam; omnes qui me oderunt diligunt mortem.]
kjv: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

wlc: חָכְמוֹת בָּנְתָה בֵיתָהּ חָצְבָה עַמּוּדֶיהָ שִׁבְעָה ׃
lxx: Ἡ σοφία οἰκοδόμησεν ἑαυτῇ οἶκον, καὶ ὑπήρεισεν στύλους ἑπτά·
vulg: sapientia aedificavit sibi domum excidit columnas septem
clem: [Sapientia dificavit sibi domum: excidit columnas septem.
kjv: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:

wlc: טָבְחָה טִבְחָהּ מָסְכָה יֵינָהּ אַף עָרְכָה שֻׁלְחָנָהּ ׃
lxx: ἔσφαξεν τὰ ἑαυτῆς θύματα, ἐκέρασεν εἰς κρατῆρα τὸν ἑαυτῆς οἶνον, καὶ ἡτοιμάσατο τὴν ἑαυτῆς τράπεζαν·
vulg: immolavit victimas suas miscuit vinum et proposuit mensam suam
clem: Immolavit victimas suas, miscuit vinum, et proposuit mensam suam.
kjv: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.

wlc: שָׁלְחָה נַעֲרֹתֶיהָ תִקְרָא עַל־גַּפֵּי מְרֹמֵי קָרֶת ׃
lxx: ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς ἑαυτῆς δούλους, συγκαλοῦσα μετὰ ὑψηλοῦ κηρύγματος ἐπὶ κρατῆρα, λέγουσα
vulg: misit ancillas suas ut vocarent ad arcem et ad moenia civitatis
clem: Misit ancillas suas ut vocarent ad arcem et ad mnia civitatis.
kjv: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,

wlc: מִי־פֶתִי יָסֻר הֵנָּה חֲסַר־לֵב אָמְרָה לּוֹ ׃
lxx: Ὅς ἐστιν ἄφρων, ἐκκλινάτω πρὸς μέ· καὶ τοῖς ἐνδεέσι φρενῶν εἶπεν
vulg: si quis est parvulus veniat ad me et insipientibus locuta est
clem: Si quis est parvulus, veniat ad me. Et insipientibus locuta est:
kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

wlc: לְכוּ לַחֲמוּ בְלַחֲמִי וּשְׁתוּ בְּיַיִן מָסָכְתִּי ׃
lxx: Ἔλθατε, φάγετε τῶν ἐμῶν ἄρτων, καὶ πίετε οἶνον ὃν ἐκέρασα ὑμῖν·
vulg: venite comedite panem meum et bibite vinum quod miscui vobis
clem: Venite, comedite panem meum, et bibite vinum quod miscui vobis.
kjv: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

wlc: עִזְבוּ פְתָאיִם וִחְיוּ וְאִשְׁרוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ בִּינָה ׃
lxx: ἀπολείπετε ἀφροσύνην, ἵνα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα βασιλεύσητε, καὶ ζητήσατε φρόνησιν, καὶ κατορθώσατε ἐν γνώσει σύνεσιν.
vulg: relinquite infantiam et vivite et ambulate per vias prudentiae
clem: Relinquite infantiam, et vivite, et ambulate per vias prudenti.]
kjv: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

wlc: יֹסֵר לֵץ לֹקֵחַ לוֹ קָלוֹן וּמוֹכִיחַ לְרָשָׁע מוּמוֹ ׃
lxx: Ὁ παιδεύων κακοὺς λήμψεται ἑαυτῷ ἀτιμίαν· ἐλέγχων δὲ τὸν ἀσεβῆ μωμήσεται ἑαυτόν.
vulg: qui erudit derisorem ipse sibi facit iniuriam et qui arguit impium generat maculam sibi
clem: [Qui erudit derisorem, ipse injuriam sibi facit, et qui arguit impium, sibi maculam generat.
kjv: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

wlc: אַל־תּוֹכַח לֵץ פֶּן־יִשְׂנָאֶךָּ הוֹכַח לְחָכָם וְיֶאֱהָבֶךָּ ׃
lxx: μὴ ἔλεγχε κακούς, ἵνα μὴ μισῶσίν σε· ἔλεγχε σοφόν, καὶ ἀγαπήσει σε.
vulg: noli arguere derisorem ne oderit te argue sapientem et diliget te
clem: Noli arguere derisorem, ne oderit te: argue sapientem, et diliget te.
kjv: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

wlc: תֵּן לְחָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־עוֹד הוֹדַע לְצַדִּיק וְיוֹסֶף לֶקַח ׃ פ
lxx: δίδου σοφῷ ἀφορμήν, καὶ σοφώτερος ἔσται· γνώριζε δικαίῳ, καὶ προσθήσει τοῦ δέχεσθαι.
vulg: da sapienti et addetur ei sapientia doce iustum et festinabit accipere
clem: Da sapienti occasionem, et addetur ei sapientia; doce justum, et festinabit accipere.
kjv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

wlc: תְּחִלַּת חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה וְדַעַת קְדֹשִׁים בִּינָה ׃
lxx: ἀρχὴ σοφίας φόβος Κυρίου, καὶ βουλὴ ἁγίων σύνεσις· τὸ γὰρ γνῶναι νόμον διανοίας ἐστὶν ἀγαθῆς.
vulg: principium sapientiae timor Domini et scientia sanctorum prudentia
clem: Principium sapienti timor Domini, et scientia sanctorum prudentia.
kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

wlc: כִּי־בִי יִרְבּוּ יָמֶיךָ וְיוֹסִיפוּ לְּךָ שְׁנוֹת חַיִּים ׃
lxx: τούτῳ γὰρ τῷ τρόπῳ πολὺν ζήσεις χρόνον, καὶ προστεθήσεταί σοι ἔτη ζωῆς σου.
vulg: per me enim multiplicabuntur dies tui et addentur tibi anni vitae
clem: Per me enim multiplicabuntur dies tui, et addentur tibi anni vit.
kjv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

wlc: אִם־חָכַמְתָּ חָכַמְתָּ לָּךְ וְלַצְתָּ לְבַדְּךָ תִשָּׂא ׃
lxx: υἱέ, ἐὰν σοφὸς γένῃ σεαυτῷ, σοφὸς ἔσῃ καὶ τοῖς πλησίον· ἐὰν δὲ κακὸς ἀποβῇς, μόνος ἂν ἀντλήσεις κακά.
vulg: si sapiens fueris tibimet ipsi eris si inlusor solus portabis malum
clem: Si sapiens fueris, tibimetipsi eris; si autem illusor, solus portabis malum.]
kjv: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

wlc: אֵשֶׁת כְּסִילוּת הֹמִיָּה פְּתַיּוּת וּבַל־יָדְעָה מָּה ׃
lxx: Γυνὴ ἄφρων καὶ θρασεῖα ἐνδεὴς ψωμοῦ γίνεται, ἣ οὐκ ἐπίσταται αἰσχύνην·
vulg: mulier stulta et clamosa plenaque inlecebris et nihil omnino sciens
clem: [Mulier stulta et clamosa, plenaque illecebris, et nihil omnino sciens,
kjv: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

wlc: וְיָשְׁבָה לְפֶתַח בֵּיתָהּ עַל־כִּסֵּא מְרֹמֵי קָרֶת ׃
lxx: ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ θύραις τοῦ ἑαυτῆς οἴκου ἐπὶ δίφρου, ἐμφανῶς ἐν πλατείαις
vulg: sedit in foribus domus suae super sellam in excelso urbis loco
clem: sedit in foribus domus su, super sellam in excelso urbis loco,
kjv: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

wlc: לִקְרֹא לְעֹבְרֵי־דָרֶךְ הַמְיַשְּׁרִים אֹרְחוֹתָם ׃
lxx: προσκαλουμένη τοὺς παριόντας καὶ κατευθύνοντας ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν
vulg: ut vocaret transeuntes viam et pergentes itinere suo
clem: ut vocaret transeuntes per viam, et pergentes itinere suo:
kjv: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

wlc: מִי־פֶתִי יָסֻר הֵנָּה וַחֲסַר־לֵב וְאָמְרָה לּוֹ ׃
lxx: Ὅs ἐστιν ὑμῶν ἀφρονέστατος, ἐκκλινάτω πρὸς μέ· ἐνδεέσι δέ φρονήσεως παρακελεύομαι λέγουσα
vulg: quis est parvulus declinet ad me et vecordi locuta est
clem: Qui est parvulus declinet ad me. Et vecordi locuta est:
kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

wlc: מַיִם־גְּנוּבִים יִמְתָּקוּ וְלֶחֶם סְתָרִים יִנְעָם ׃
lxx: Ἄρτων κρυφίων ἡδέως ἅψασθε, καὶ ὕδατος κλοπῆς γλυκεροῦ.
vulg: aquae furtivae dulciores sunt et panis absconditus suavior
clem: Aqu furtiv dulciores sunt, et panis absconditus suavior.
kjv: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

wlc: וְלֹא־יָדַע כִּי־רְפָאִים שָׁם בְּעִמְקֵי שְׁאוֹל קְרֻאֶיהָ ׃ פ
lxx: ό δὲ οὐκ οἶδεν ὅτι γηγενεῖς παρʼ αὐτῇ ὄλλυνται, καὶ ἐπὶ πέτευρον ἅδου συναντᾷ.
vulg: et ignoravit quod gigantes ibi sint et in profundis inferni convivae eius
clem: Et ignoravit quod ibi sint gigantes, et in profundis inferni conviv ejus.]
kjv: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.

wlc: מִשְׁלֵי שְׁלֹמֹה פ בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָב וּבֵן כְּסִיל תּוּגַת אִמּוֹ ׃
lxx: Υἱὸς σοφὸς εὐφραίνει πατέρα, υἱὸς δὲ ἄφρων λύπη τῇ μητρί
vulg: parabolae Salomonis filius sapiens laetificat patrem filius vero stultus maestitia est matris suae
clem: [Filius sapiens ltificat patrem, filius vero stultus mstitia est matris su.
kjv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

wlc: לֹא־יוֹעִילוּ אוֹצְרוֹת רֶשַׁע וּצְדָקָה תַּצִּיל מִמָּוֶת ׃
lxx: οὐκ ὠφελήσουσιν θησαυροὶ ἀνόμους, δικαιοσύνη δὲ ῥύσεται ἐκ θανάτου.
vulg: non proderunt thesauri impietatis iustitia vero liberabit a morte
clem: Nil proderunt thesauri impietatis, justitia vero liberabit a morte.
kjv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.

wlc: לֹא־יַרְעִיב יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְהַוַּת רְשָׁעִים יֶהְדֹּף ׃
lxx: οὐ λιμοκτονήσει Κύριος ψυχὴν δικαίαν, ζωὴν δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀνατρέψει.
vulg: non adfliget Dominus fame animam iusti et insidias impiorum subvertet
clem: Non affliget Dominus fame animam justi, et insidias impiorum subvertet.
kjv: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

wlc: רָאשׁ עֹשֶׂה כַף־רְמִיָּה וְיַד חָרוּצִים תַּעֲשִׁיר ׃
lxx: πενία ἄνδρα ταπεινοῖ, χεῖρες δὲ ἀνδρείων πλουτίζουσιν.
vulg: egestatem operata est manus remissa manus autem fortium divitias parat
clem: Egestatem operata est manus remissa; manus autem fortium divitias parat. Qui nititur mendaciis, hic pascit ventos; idem autem ipse sequitur aves volantes.
kjv: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

wlc: אֹגֵר בַּקַּיִץ בֵּן מַשְׂכִּיל נִרְדָּם בַּקָּצִיר בֵּן מֵבִישׁ ׃
lxx: διεσώθη ἀπὸ καύματος υἱὸς νοήμων, ἀνεμόφθορος δὲ γίνεται ἐν ἀμήτῳ υἱὸς παράνομος.
vulg: qui congregat in messe filius sapiens est qui autem stertit aestate filius confusionis
clem: Qui congregat in messe, filius sapiens est; qui autem stertit state, filius confusionis.
kjv: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

wlc: בְּרָכוֹת לְרֹאשׁ צַדִּיק וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְכַסֶּה חָמָס ׃
lxx: εὐλογία Κυρίου ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν δικαίου, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν καλύψει πένθος ἄωρον.
vulg: benedictio super caput iusti os autem impiorum operit iniquitatem
clem: Benedictio Domini super caput justi; os autem impiorum operit iniquitas.
kjv: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

wlc: זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה וְשֵׁם רְשָׁעִים יִרְקָב ׃
lxx: μνήμη δικαίων μετʼ ἐγκωμίων, ὄνομα δὲ ἀσεβοῦς σβέννυται.
vulg: memoria iusti cum laudibus et nomen impiorum putrescet
clem: Memoria justi cum laudibus, et nomen impiorum putrescet.
kjv: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

wlc: חֲכַם־לֵב יִקַּח מִצְוֹת וֶאֱוִיל שְׂפָתַיִם יִלָּבֵט ׃
lxx: σοφὸς καρδίᾳ δέξεται ἐντολάς, ὁ δὲ ἄστεγος χείλεσιν σκολιάζων ὑποσκελισθήσεται.
vulg: sapiens corde praecepta suscipiet stultus caeditur labiis
clem: Sapiens corde prcepta suscipit; stultus cditur labiis.
kjv: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

wlc: הוֹלֵךְ בַּתֹּם יֵלֶךְ בֶּטַח וּמְעַקֵּשׁ דְּרָכָיו יִוָּדֵעַ ׃
lxx: ὃς πορεύεται ἁπλῶς, πορεύεται πεποιθώς· ὁ δὲ διαστρέφων τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ γνωσθήσεται.
vulg: qui ambulat simpliciter ambulat confidenter qui autem depravat vias suas manifestus erit
clem: Qui ambulat simpliciter ambulat confidenter; qui autem depravat vias suas manifestus erit.
kjv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

wlc: קֹרֵץ עַיִן יִתֵּן עַצָּבֶת וֶאֱוִיל שְׂפָתַיִם יִלָּבֵט ׃
lxx: ὁ ἐννεύων ὀφθαλμοῖς μετὰ δόλου συνάγει ἀνδράσι λύπας, ὁ δὲ ἐλέγχων μετὰ παρρησίας εἰρηνοποιεῖ.
vulg: qui annuit oculo dabit dolorem stultus labiis verberabitur
clem: Qui annuit oculo dabit dolorem; et stultus labiis verberabitur.]
kjv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

wlc: מְקוֹר חַיִּים פִּי צַדִּיק וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְכַסֶּה חָמָס ׃
lxx: πηγὴ ζωῆς ἐν χειρὶ δικαίου, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβοῦς καλύψει ἀπώλεια.
vulg: vena vitae os iusti et os impiorum operiet iniquitatem
clem: [Vena vit os justi, et os impiorum operit iniquitatem.
kjv: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

wlc: שִׂנְאָה תְּעוֹרֵר מְדָנִים וְעַל כָּל־פְּשָׁעִים תְּכַסֶּה אַהֲבָה ׃
lxx: μῖσος ἐγείρει νεῖκος, πάντας δὲ τοὺς μὴ φιλονεικοῦντας καλύπτει φιλία·
vulg: odium suscitat rixas et universa delicta operit caritas
clem: Odium suscitat rixas, et universa delicta operit caritas.
kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

wlc: בְּשִׂפְתֵי נָבוֹן תִּמָּצֵא חָכְמָה וְשֵׁבֶט לְגֵו חֲסַר־לֵב ׃
lxx: ῥάβδῳ τύπτει ἄνδρα ἀκάρδιον.
vulg: in labiis sapientis invenietur sapientia et virga in dorso eius qui indiget corde
clem: In labiis sapientis invenitur sapientia, et virga in dorso ejus qui indiget corde.
kjv: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

wlc: חֲכָמִים יִצְפְּנוּ־דָעַת וּפִי־אֱוִיל מְחִתָּה קְרֹבָה ׃
lxx: σοφοὶ κρύψουσιν αἴσθησιν, στόμα δὲ προπετοῦς ἐγγίζει συντριβῇ.
vulg: sapientes abscondunt scientiam os autem stulti confusioni proximum est
clem: Sapientes abscondunt scientiam; os autem stulti confusioni proximum est.
kjv: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

wlc: הוֹן עָשִׁיר קִרְיַת עֻזּוֹ מְחִתַּת דַּלִּים רֵישָׁם ׃
lxx: κτῆσις πλουσίων πόλις ὀχυρά, συντριβὴ δὲ ἀσεβῶν πενία.
vulg: substantia divitis urbs fortitudinis eius pavor pauperum egestas eorum
clem: Substantia divitis, urbs fortitudinis ejus; pavor pauperum egestas eorum.
kjv: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.

wlc: פְּעֻלַּת צַדִּיק לְחַיִּים תְּבוּאַת רָשָׁע לְחַטָּאת ׃
lxx: ἔργα δικαίων ζωὴν ποιεῖ, καρποὶ δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἁμαρτίας.
vulg: opus iusti ad vitam fructus impii ad peccatum
clem: Opus justi ad vitam, fructus autem impii ad peccatum.
kjv: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

wlc: אֹרַח לְחַיִּים שׁוֹמֵר מוּסָר וְעוֹזֵב תּוֹכַחַת מַתְעֶה ׃
lxx: ὁδοὺς δικαίας ζωῆς φυλάσσει παιδεία, παιδεία δὲ ἀνεξέλεγκτος πλανᾶται.
vulg: via vitae custodienti disciplinam qui autem increpationes relinquit errat
clem: Via vit custodienti disciplinam; qui autem increpationes relinquit, errat.
kjv: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.

wlc: מְכַסֶּה שִׂנְאָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁקֶר וּמוֹצִא דִבָּה הוּא כְסִיל ׃
lxx: καλύπτουσιν ἔχθραν χείλη δίκαια, οἱ δὲ ἐκφέροντες λοιδορίας ἀφρονέστατοί εἰσιν.
vulg: abscondunt odium labia mendacia qui profert contumeliam insipiens est
clem: Abscondunt odium labia mendacia; qui profert contumeliam, insipiens est.
kjv: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

wlc: בְּרֹב דְּבָרִים לֹא יֶחְדַּל־פָּשַׁע וְחֹשֵׂךְ שְׂפָתָיו מַשְׂכִּיל ׃
lxx: ἐκ πολυλογίας οὐκ ἐκφεύξῃ ἁμαρτίαν, φειδόμενος δὲ χειλέων νοήμων ἔσῃ.
vulg: in multiloquio peccatum non deerit qui autem moderatur labia sua prudentissimus est
clem: In multiloquio non deerit peccatum, qui autem moderatur labia sua prudentissimus est.
kjv: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.

wlc: כֶּסֶף נִבְחָר לְשׁוֹן צַדִּיק לֵב רְשָׁעִים כִּמְעָט ׃
lxx: ἄργυρος πεπυρωμένος γλῶσσα δικαίου, καρδία δὲ ἀσεβοῦς ἐκλείψει.
vulg: argentum electum lingua iusti cor impiorum pro nihilo
clem: Argentum electum lingua justi; cor autem impiorum pro nihilo.
kjv: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

wlc: שִׂפְתֵי צַדִּיק יִרְעוּ רַבִּים וֶאֱוִילִים בַּחֲסַר־לֵב יָמוּתוּ ׃
lxx: χείλη δικαίων ἐπίσταται ὑψηλά, οἱ δὲ ἄφρονες ἐν ἐνδείᾳ τελευτῶσιν.
vulg: labia iusti erudiunt plurimos qui autem indocti sunt in cordis egestate morientur
clem: Labia justi erudiunt plurimos; qui autem indocti sunt in cordis egestate morientur.]
kjv: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

wlc: בִּרְכַּת יְהוָה הִיא תַעֲשִׁיר וְלֹא־יוֹסִף עֶצֶב עִמָּהּ ׃
lxx: εὐλογία Κυρίου ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν δικαίου· αὕτη πλουτίζει, καὶ οὐ μὴ προστεθῇ αὐτῇ λύπη ἐν καρδίᾳ.
vulg: benedictio Domini divites facit nec sociabitur ei adflictio
clem: [Benedictio Domini divites facit, nec sociabitur eis afflictio.
kjv: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

wlc: כִּשְׂחוֹק לִכְסִיל עֲשׂוֹת זִמָּה וְחָכְמָה לְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה ׃
lxx: ἐν γέλωτι ἄφρων πράσσει κακά, ἡ δὲ σοφία ἀνδρὶ τίκτει φρόνησιν.
vulg: quasi per risum stultus operatur scelus sapientia autem est viro prudentia
clem: Quasi per risum stultus operatur scelus, sapientia autem est viro prudentia.
kjv: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

wlc: מְגוֹרַת רָשָׁע הִיא תְבוֹאֶנּוּ וְתַאֲוַת צַדִּיקִים יִתֵּן ׃
lxx: ἐν ἀπωλείᾳ ἀσεβὴς περιφέρεται, ἐπιθυμία δὲ δικαίου δεκτή.
vulg: quod timet impius veniet super eum desiderium suum iustis dabitur
clem: Quod timet impius veniet super eum; desiderium suum justus dabitur.
kjv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

wlc: כַּעֲבוֹר סוּפָה וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְצַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם ׃
lxx: παραπορευομένης καταιγίδος ἀφανίζεται ἀσεβής, δίκαιος δὲ ἐκκλίνας σώζεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
vulg: quasi tempestas transiens non erit impius iustus autem quasi fundamentum sempiternum
clem: Quasi tempestas transiens non erit impius; justus autem quasi fundamentum sempiternum.
kjv: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

wlc: כַּחֹמֶץ לַשִּׁנַּיִם וְכֶעָשָׁן לָעֵינָיִם כֵּן הֶעָצֵל לְשֹׁלְחָיו ׃
lxx: ὥσπερ ὄμφαξ ὀδοῦσι βλαβερὸν καὶ καπνὸς ὄμμασιν, οὕτως παρανομία τοῖς χρωμένοις αὐτὴν.
vulg: sicut acetum dentibus et fumus oculis sic piger his qui miserunt eum
clem: Sicut acetum dentibus, et fumus oculis, sic piger his qui miserunt eum.
kjv: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

wlc: יִרְאַת יְהוָה תּוֹסִיף יָמִים וּשְׁנוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּקְצֹרְנָה ׃
lxx: φόβος Κυρίου προστίθησιν ἡμέρας, ἔτη δὲ ἀσεβῶν ὀλιγωθήσεται.
vulg: timor Domini adponet dies et anni impiorum breviabuntur
clem: Timor Domini apponet dies, et anni impiorum breviabuntur.
kjv: The fear of the Lord prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

wlc: תּוֹחֶלֶת צַדִּיקִים שִׂמְחָה וְתִקְוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד ׃
lxx: ἐνχρονίζει δικαίοις εὐφροσύνη, ἐλπὶς δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀπολεῖται.
vulg: expectatio iustorum laetitia spes autem impiorum peribit
clem: Exspectatio justorum ltitia, spes autem impiorum peribit.
kjv: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

wlc: מָעוֹז לַתֹּם דֶּרֶךְ יְהוָה וּמְחִתָּה לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן ׃
lxx: ὀχύρωμα ὁσίου φόβος Κυρίου, συντριβὴ δὲ τοῖς ἐργαζομένοις κακά.
vulg: fortitudo simplicis via Domini et pavor his qui operantur malum
clem: Fortitudo simplicis via Domini, et pavor his qui operantur malum.
kjv: The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

wlc: צַדִּיק לְעוֹלָם בַּל־יִמּוֹט וּרְשָׁעִים לֹא יִשְׁכְּנוּ־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: δίκαιος τὸν αἰῶνα οὐκ ἐνδώσει, ἀσεβεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἰκήσουσιν γῆν.
vulg: iustus in aeternum non commovebitur impii autem non habitabunt in terram
clem: Justus in ternum non commovebitur, impii autem non habitabunt super terram.
kjv: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

wlc: פִּי־צַדִּיק יָנוּב חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹן תַּהְפֻּכוֹת תִּכָּרֵת ׃
lxx: στόμα δικαίου ἀποστάζει σοφίαν, γλῶσσα δὲ ἀδίκου ἐξολεῖται.
vulg: os iusti parturiet sapientiam lingua pravorum peribit
clem: Os justi parturiet sapientiam; lingua pravorum peribit.
kjv: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

wlc: שִׂפְתֵי צַדִּיק יֵדְעוּן רָצוֹן וּפִי רְשָׁעִים תַּהְפֻּכוֹת ׃
lxx: χείλη ἀνδρῶν δικαίων ἀποστάζει χάριτας, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀποστρέφεται.
vulg: labia iusti considerant placita et os impiorum perversa
clem: Labia justi considerant placita, et os impiorum perversa.]
kjv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.

wlc: מֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה וְאֶבֶן שְׁלֵמָה רְצוֹנוֹ ׃
lxx: ζυγοὶ δόλιοι βδέλυγμα ἐνώπιον Κυρίου, στάθμιον δὲ δίκαιον δεκτὸν αὐτῷ.
vulg: statera dolosa abominatio apud Dominum et pondus aequum voluntas eius
clem: [Statera dolosa abominatio est apud Dominum, et pondus quum voluntas ejus.
kjv: A false balance is abomination to the Lord: but a just weight is his delight.

wlc: בָּא־זָדוֹן וַיָּבֹא קָלוֹן וְאֶת־צְנוּעִים חָכְמָה ׃
lxx: οὗ ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃ ὕβρις, ἐκεῖ καὶ ἀτιμία· στόμα δὲ ταπεινῶν μελετᾷ σοφίαν.
vulg: ubi fuerit superbia ibi erit et contumelia ubi autem humilitas ibi et sapientia
clem: Ubi fuerit superbia, ibi erit et contumelia; ubi autem est humilitas, ibi et sapientia.
kjv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

wlc: תֻּמַּת יְשָׁרִים תַּנְחֵם וְסֶלֶף בּוֹגְדִים וְשַׁדָּם ׃
lxx: ἀποθανὼν δίκαιος ἔλιπεν μετάμελον, πρόχειρος δὲ γίνεται καὶ ἐπίχαρτος ἀσεβῶν ἀπώλεια.
vulg: simplicitas iustorum diriget eos et subplantatio perversorum vastabit illos
clem: Simplicitas justorum diriget eos, et supplantatio perversorum vastabit illos.
kjv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

wlc: לֹא־יוֹעִיל הוֹן בְּיוֹם עֶבְרָה וּצְדָקָה תַּצִּיל מִמָּוֶת ׃
vulg: non proderunt divitiae in die ultionis iustitia autem liberabit a morte
clem: Non proderunt diviti in die ultionis; justitia autem liberabit a morte.
kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.

wlc: צִדְקַת תָּמִים תְּיַשֵּׁר דַּרְכּוֹ וּבְרִשְׁעָתוֹ יִפֹּל רָשָׁע ׃
lxx: δικαιοσύνη ἀμώμους ὀρθοτομεῖ ὁδούς, ἀσέβεια δὲ περιπίπτει ἀδικίᾳ.
vulg: iustitia simplicis diriget viam eius et in impietate sua corruet impius
clem: Justitia simplicis diriget viam ejus, et in impietate sua corruet impius.
kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

wlc: צִדְקַת יְשָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵם וּבְהַוַּת בֹּגְדִים יִלָּכֵדוּ ׃
lxx: δικαιοσύνη ἀνδρῶν ὀρθῶν ῥύεται αὐτούς, τῇ δὲ ἀπωλείᾳ αὐτῶν ἁλίσκονται παράνομοι.
vulg: iustitia rectorum liberabit eos et in insidiis suis capientur iniqui
clem: Justitia rectorum liberabit eos, et in insidiis suis capientur iniqui.
kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

wlc: בְּמוֹת אָדָם רָשָׁע תֹּאבַד תִּקְוָה וְתוֹחֶלֶת אוֹנִים אָבָדָה ׃
lxx: τελευτήσαντος ἀνδρὸς δικαίου οὐκ ὄλλυται ἐλπίς, τὸ δὲ καύχημα τῶν ἀσεβῶν ὄλλυται.
vulg: mortuo homine impio nulla erit ultra spes et expectatio sollicitorum peribit
clem: Mortuo homine impio, nulla erit ultra spes, et exspectatio sollicitorum peribit.
kjv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.

wlc: צַדִּיק מִצָּרָה נֶחֱלָץ וַיָּבֹא רָשָׁע תַּחְתָּיו ׃
lxx: δίκαιος ἐκ θήρας ἐκδύνει, ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ δὲ παραδίδοται ὁ ἀσεβής.
vulg: iustus de angustia liberatus est et tradetur impius pro eo
clem: Justus de angustia liberatus est, et tradetur impius pro eo.]
kjv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

wlc: בְּפֶה חָנֵף יַשְׁחִת רֵעֵהוּ וּבְדַעַת צַדִּיקִים יֵחָלֵצוּ ׃
lxx: ἐν στόματι ἀσεβῶν παγὶς πολίταις, αἴσθησις δὲ δικαίων εὔοδος.
vulg: simulator ore decipit amicum suum iusti autem liberabuntur scientia
clem: [Simulator ore decipit amicum suum; justi autem liberabuntur scientia.
kjv: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

wlc: בְּטוּב צַדִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹץ קִרְיָה וּבַאֲבֹד רְשָׁעִים רִנָּה ׃
lxx: ἐν ἀγαθοῖς δικαίων κατώρθωσεν πόλις,
vulg: in bonis iustorum exultabit civitas et in perditione impiorum erit laudatio
clem: In bonis justorum exsultabit civitas, et in perditione impiorum erit laudatio.
kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

wlc: בְּבִרְכַּת יְשָׁרִים תָּרוּם קָרֶת וּבְפִי רְשָׁעִים תֵּהָרֵס ׃
lxx: στόμασιν δὲ ἀσεβῶν κατεσκάφη.
vulg: benedictione iustorum exaltabitur civitas et ore impiorum subvertetur
clem: Benedictione justorum exaltabitur civitas, et ore impiorum subvertetur.
kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

wlc: בָּז־לְרֵעֵהוּ חֲסַר־לֵב וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנוֹת יַחֲרִישׁ ׃
lxx: μυκτηρίζει πολίτας ἐνδεὴς φρενῶν, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος ἡσυχίαν ἄγει.
vulg: qui despicit amicum suum indigens corde est vir autem prudens tacebit
clem: Qui despicit amicum suum indigens corde est; vir autem prudens tacebit.
kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

wlc: הוֹלֵךְ רָכִיל מְגַלֶּה־סּוֹד וְנֶאֱמַן־רוּחַ מְכַסֶּה דָבָר ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ δίγλωσσος ἀποκαλύπτει βουλὰς ἐν συνεδρίῳ, πιστὸς δὲ πνοῇ κρύπτει πράγματα.
vulg: qui ambulat fraudulenter revelat arcana qui autem fidelis est animi celat commissum
clem: Qui ambulat fraudulenter, revelat arcana; qui autem fidelis est animi, celat amici commissum.
kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

wlc: בְּאֵין תַּחְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל־עָם וּתְשׁוּעָה בְּרֹב יוֹעֵץ ׃
lxx: οἷς μὴ ὑπάρχει κυβέρνησις, πίπτουσιν ὥσπερ φύλλα, σωτηρία δὲ ὑπάρχει ἐν πολλῇ βουλῇ.
vulg: ubi non est gubernator populus corruet salus autem ubi multa consilia
clem: Ubi non est gubernator, populus corruet; salus autem, ubi multa consilia.
kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

wlc: רַע־יֵרוֹעַ כִּי־עָרַב זָר וְשֹׂנֵא תֹקְעִים בּוֹטֵחַ ׃
lxx: πονηρὸς κακοποιεῖ ὅταν συνμίξῃ δικαίῳ, μισεῖ δὲ ἦχον ἀσφαλείας.
vulg: adfligetur malo qui fidem facit pro extraneo qui autem cavet laqueos securus erit
clem: Affligetur malo qui fidem facit pro extraneo; qui autem cavet laqueos securus erit.
kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

wlc: אֵשֶׁת־חֵן תִּתְמֹךְ כָּבוֹד וְעָרִיצִים יִתְמְכוּ־עֹשֶׁר ׃
lxx: γυνὴ εὐχάριστος ἐγείρει ἀνδρὶ δόξαν, θρόνος δὲ ἀτιμίας γυνὴ μισοῦσα δίκαια. πλούτου ὀκνηροὶ ἐνδεεῖς γίνονται, οἱ δὲ ἀνδρεῖοι ἐρείδονται πλούτῳ.
vulg: mulier gratiosa inveniet gloriam et robusti habebunt divitias
clem: Mulier gratiosa inveniet gloriam, et robusti habebunt divitias.]
kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

wlc: גֹּמֵל נַפְשׁוֹ אִישׁ חָסֶד וְעֹכֵר שְׁאֵרוֹ אַכְזָרִי ׃
lxx: τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ ἀγαθὸν ποιεῖ ἀνὴρ ἐλεήμων, ἐξολλύει δὲ αὐτοῦ σῶμα ὁ ἀνελεήμων.
vulg: benefacit animae suae vir misericors qui autem crudelis est et propinquos abicit
clem: [Benefacit anim su vir misericors; qui autem crudelis est, etiam propinquos abjicit.
kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

wlc: רָשָׁע עֹשֶׂה פְעֻלַּת־שָׁקֶר וְזֹרֵעַ צְדָקָה שֶׂכֶר אֱמֶת ׃
lxx: ἀσεβὴς ποιεῖ ἔργα ἄδικα, σπέρμα δὲ δικαίων μισθὸς ἀληθείας.
vulg: impius facit opus instabile seminanti autem iustitiam merces fidelis
clem: Impius facit opus instabile, seminanti autem justitiam merces fidelis.
kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

wlc: כֵּן־צְדָקָה לְחַיִּים וּמְרַדֵּף רָעָה לְמוֹתוֹ ׃
lxx: υἱὸς δίκαιος γεννᾶται εἰς ζωήν, διωγμὸς δὲ ἀσεβοῦς εἰς θάνατον.
vulg: clementia praeparat vitam et sectatio malorum mortem
clem: Clementia prparat vitam, et sectatio malorum mortem.
kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

wlc: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־לֵב וּרְצוֹנוֹ תְּמִימֵי דָרֶךְ ׃
lxx: βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ διεστραμμέναι ὁδοί, προσδεκτοὶ δὲ αὐτῷ πάντες ἄμωμοι ἐν ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτῶν.
vulg: abominabile Domino pravum cor et voluntas eius in his qui simpliciter ambulant
clem: Abominabile Domino cor pravum, et voluntas ejus in iis qui simpliciter ambulant.
kjv: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the Lord: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

wlc: יָד לְיָד לֹא־יִנָּקֶה רָּע וְזֶרַע צַדִּיקִים נִמְלָט ׃
lxx: χειρὶ χεῖρας ἐμβαλὼν ἀδίκως οὐκ ἀτιμώρητος ἔσται, ὁ δὲ σπείρων δικαιοσύνην λήμψεται μισθὸν πιστόν.
vulg: manus in manu non erit innocens malus semen autem iustorum salvabitur
clem: Manus in manu non erit innocens malus; semen autem justorum salvabitur.
kjv: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

wlc: נֶזֶם זָהָב בְּאַף חֲזִיר אִשָּׁה יָפָה וְסָרַת טָעַם ׃
lxx: ὥσπερ ἐνώτιον ἐν ῥινὶ ὑός, οὕτως γυναικὶ κακόφρονι κάλλος.
vulg: circulus aureus in naribus suis mulier pulchra et fatua
clem: Circulus aureus in naribus suis, mulier pulchra et fatua.
kjv: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

wlc: תַּאֲוַת צַדִּיקִים אַךְ־טוֹב תִּקְוַת רְשָׁעִים עֶבְרָה ׃
lxx: ἐπιθυμία δικαίων πᾶσα ἀγαθή, ἐλπὶς δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀπολεῖται.
vulg: desiderium iustorum omne bonum est praestolatio impiorum furor
clem: Desiderium justorum omne bonum est; prstolatio impiorum furor.
kjv: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

wlc: יֵשׁ מְפַזֵּר וְנוֹסָף עוֹד וְחוֹשֵׂךְ מִיֹּשֶׁר אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר ׃
lxx: εἰσὶν οἳ τὰ ἴδια σπείροντες πλείονα ποιοῦσιν· εἰσὶν καὶ οἳ συνάγοντες ἐλαττονοῦνται.
vulg: alii dividunt propria et ditiores fiunt alii rapiunt non sua et semper in egestate sunt
clem: Alii dividunt propria, et ditiores fiunt; alii rapiunt non sua, et semper in egestate sunt.
kjv: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

wlc: נֶפֶשׁ־בְּרָכָה תְדֻשָּׁן וּמַרְוֶה גַּם־הוּא יוֹרֶא ׃
lxx: ψυχὴ εὐλογουμένη πᾶσα ἁπλῆ, ἀνὴρ δὲ θυμώδης οὐκ εὐσχήμων.
vulg: anima quae benedicit inpinguabitur et qui inebriat ipse quoque inebriabitur
clem: Anima qu benedicit impinguabitur, et qui inebriat, ipse quoque inebriabitur.
kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

wlc: מֹנֵעַ בָּר יִקְּבֻהוּ לְאוֹם וּבְרָכָה לְרֹאשׁ מַשְׁבִּיר ׃
lxx: ὁ συνέχων σῖτον, ὑπολίποιτο αὐτὸν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν· εὐλογία δὲ εἰς κεφαλὴν τοῦ μεταδιδόντος.
vulg: qui abscondit frumenta maledicetur in populis benedictio autem super caput vendentium
clem: Qui abscondit frumenta maledicetur in populis; benedictio autem super caput vendentium.
kjv: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

wlc: שֹׁחֵר טוֹב יְבַקֵּשׁ רָצוֹן וְדֹרֵשׁ רָעָה תְבוֹאֶנּוּ ׃
lxx: τεκταινόμενος ἀγαθὰ ζητεῖ χάριν ἀγαθήν, ἐκζητοῦντα δὲ κακὰ καταλήμψεται αὐτόν.
vulg: bene consurgit diluculo qui quaerit bona qui autem investigator malorum est opprimetur ab eis
clem: Bene consurgit diluculo qui qurit bona; qui autem investigator malorum est, opprimetur ab eis.
kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

wlc: בּוֹטֵחַ בְּעָשְׁרוֹ הוּא יִפֹּל וְכֶעָלֶה צַדִּיקִים יִפְרָחוּ ׃
lxx: ὁ πεποιθὼς ἐπὶ πλούτῳ, οὗτος πεσεῖται, ὁ δὲ ἀντιλαμβανόμενος δικαίων, οὗτος ἀνατελεῖ.
vulg: qui confidet in divitiis suis corruet iusti autem quasi virens folium germinabunt
clem: Qui confidit in divitiis suis corruet: justi autem quasi virens folium germinabunt.
kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

wlc: עוֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ יִנְחַל־רוּחַ וְעֶבֶד אֱוִיל לַחֲכַם־לֵב ׃
lxx: ὁ μὴ συνπεριφερόμενος τῷ ἑαυτοῦ οἴκῳ κληρονομήσει ἄνεμον, δουλεύσει δὲ ἄφρων φρονίμῳ.
vulg: qui conturbat domum suam possidebit ventos et qui stultus est serviet sapienti
clem: Qui conturbat domum suam possidebit ventos, et qui stultus est serviet sapienti.
kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

wlc: פְּרִי־צַדִּיק עֵץ חַיִּים וְלֹקֵחַ נְפָשׂוֹת חָכָם ׃
lxx: ἐκ καρποῦ δικαιοσύνης φύεται δένδρον ζωῆς, ἀφαιροῦνται δὲ ἄωροι ψυχαὶ παρανόμαων.
vulg: fructus iusti lignum vitae et qui suscipit animas sapiens est
clem: Fructus justi lignum vit, et qui suscipit animas sapiens est.
kjv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.

wlc: הֵן צַדִּיק בָּאָרֶץ יְשֻׁלָּם אַף כִּי־רָשָׁע וְחוֹטֵא ׃
lxx: εἰ ὁ μὲν δίκαιος μόλις σώζεται, ὁ ἀσεβὴς καὶ ἁμαρτωλὸς ποῦ φανεῖται;
vulg: si iustus in terra recipit quanto magis impius et peccator
clem: Si justus in terra recipit, quanto magis impius et peccator!]
kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.

wlc: אֹהֵב מוּסָר אֹהֵב דָּעַת וְשֹׂנֵא תוֹכַחַת בָּעַר ׃
lxx: ὁ ἀγαπῶν παιδείαν ἀγαπᾷ αἴσθησιν, ὁ δὲ μισῶν ἐλέγχους ἄφρων.
vulg: qui diligit disciplinam diligit scientiam qui autem odit increpationes insipiens est
clem: [Qui diligit disciplinam diligit scientiam; qui autem odit increpationes insipiens est.
kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.

wlc: טוֹב יָפִיק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה וְאִישׁ מְזִמּוֹת יַרְשִׁיעַ ׃
lxx: κρείσσων ὁ εὑρὼν χάριν παρὰ Κυρίῳ, ἀνὴρ δὲ παράνομος παρασιωπηθήσεται.
vulg: qui bonus est hauriet a Domino gratiam qui autem confidit cogitationibus suis impie agit
clem: Qui bonus est hauriet gratiam a Domino; qui autem confidit in cogitationibus suis impie agit.
kjv: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

wlc: לֹא־יִכּוֹן אָדָם בְּרֶשַׁע וְשֹׁרֶשׁ צַדִּיקִים בַּל־יִמּוֹט ׃
lxx: οὐ κατορθώσει ἄνθρωπος ἐξ ἀνόμου, αἱ δὲ ῥίζαι τῶν δικαίων οὐκ ἐξαρθήσονται.
vulg: non roborabitur homo ex impietate et radix iustorum non commovebitur
clem: Non roborabitur homo ex impietate, et radix justorum non commovebitur.
kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

wlc: אֵשֶׁת־חַיִל עֲטֶרֶת בַּעְלָהּ וּכְרָקָב בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו מְבִישָׁה ׃
lxx: γυνὴ ἀνδρεία στέφανος τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς· ὥσπερ δὲ ἐν ξύλῳ σκώληξ, οὕτως ἄνδρα ἀπόλλυσιν γυνὴ κακοποιός.
vulg: mulier diligens corona viro suo et putredo in ossibus eius quae confusione res dignas gerit
clem: Mulier diligens corona est viro suo; et putredo in ossibus ejus, qu confusione res dignas gerit.
kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

wlc: מַחְשְׁבוֹת צַדִּיקִים מִשְׁפָּט תַּחְבֻּלוֹת רְשָׁעִים מִרְמָה ׃
lxx: λογισμοὶ δικαίων κρίματα, κυβερνῶσιν δὲ ἀσεβεῖς δόλους.
vulg: cogitationes iustorum iudicia et consilia impiorum fraudulentia
clem: Cogitationes justorum judicia, et consilia impiorum fraudulenta.
kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

wlc: דִּבְרֵי רְשָׁעִים אֱרָב־דָּם וּפִי יְשָׁרִים יַצִּילֵם ׃
lxx: λόγοι ἀσεβῶν δόλιοι, στόμα δὲ ὀρθῶν ῥύσεται αὐτούς.
vulg: verba impiorum insidiantur sanguini os iustorum liberabit eos
clem: Verba impiorum insidiantur sanguini; os justorum liberabit eos.
kjv: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

wlc: הָפוֹךְ רְשָׁעִים וְאֵינָם וּבֵית צַדִּיקִים יַעֲמֹד ׃
lxx: οὗ ἐὰν στραφῇ, ἀσεβὴς ἀφανίζεται, οἶκοι δὲ δικαίων παραμένουσιν.
vulg: verte impios et non erunt domus autem iustorum permanebit
clem: Verte impios, et non erunt; domus autem justorum permanebit.
kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

wlc: לְפִי־שִׂכְלוֹ יְהֻלַּל־אִישׁ וְנַעֲוֵה־לֵב יִהְיֶה לָבוּז ׃
lxx: στόμα συνετοῦ ἐγκωμιάζεται ὑπὸ ἀνδρός, νωθροκάρδιος δὲ μυκτηρίζεται.
vulg: doctrina sua noscetur vir qui autem vanus et excors est patebit contemptui
clem: Doctrina sua noscetur vir; qui autem vanus et excors est patebit contemptui.
kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

wlc: טוֹב נִקְלֶה וְעֶבֶד לוֹ מִמְּתַכַּבֵּד וַחֲסַר־לָחֶם ׃
lxx: κρείσσων ἀνὴρ ἐν ἀτιμίᾳ δουλεύων ἑαυτῷ, ἢ τιμὴν ἑαυτῷ περιτιθεὶς καὶ προσδεόμενος ἄρτου.
vulg: melior est pauper et sufficiens sibi quam gloriosus et indigens pane
clem: Melior est pauper et sufficiens sibi quam gloriosus et indigens pane.
kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

wlc: יוֹדֵעַ צַדִּיק נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּוֹ וְרַחֲמֵי רְשָׁעִים אַכְזָרִי ׃
lxx: δίκαιος οἰκτείρει ψυχὰς κτηνῶν αὐτοῦ. τὰ δὲ σπλάγχνα τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνελεήμονα.
vulg: novit iustus animas iumentorum suorum viscera autem impiorum crudelia
clem: Novit justus jumentorum suorum animas; viscera autem impiorum crudelia.
kjv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

wlc: עֹבֵד אַדְמָתוֹ יִשְׂבַּע־לָחֶם וּמְרַדֵּף רֵיקִים חֲסַר־לֵב ׃
lxx: ὁ ἐργαζόμενος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γῆν ἐμπλησθήσεται ἄρτων. οἱ δὲ διώκοντες μάταια ἐνδεεῖς φρενῶν.
vulg: qui operatur terram suam saturabitur panibus qui autem sectatur otium stultissimus est
clem: Qui operatur terram suam satiabitur panibus; qui autem sectatur otium stultissimus est. Qui suavis est in vini demorationibus, in suis munitionibus relinquit contumeliam.
kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

wlc: חָמַד רָשָׁע מְצוֹד רָעִים וְשֹׁרֶשׁ צַדִּיקִים יִתֵּן ׃
lxx: ἐπιθυμίαι ἀσεβῶν κακαί, αἱ δὲ ῥίζαι τῶν εὐσεβῶν ἐν ὀχυρώμασιν.
vulg: desiderium impii munimentum est pessimorum radix autem iustorum proficiet
clem: Desiderium impii munimentum est pessimorum; radix autem justorum proficiet.]
kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

wlc: בְּפֶשַׁע שְׂפָתַיִם מוֹקֵשׁ רָע וַיֵּצֵא מִצָּרָה צַדִּיק ׃
lxx: δι᾿ ἁμαρτίαν χειλέων ἐμπίπτει εἰς παγίδας ἁμαρτωλός, ἐκφεύγει δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν δίκαιος.
vulg: propter peccata labiorum ruina proximat malo effugiet autem iustus de angustia
clem: [Propter peccata labiorum ruina proximat malo; effugiet autem justus de angustia.
kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

wlc: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ יִשְׂבַּע־טוֹב וּגְמוּל יְדֵי־אָדָם יָשׁוּב לוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ καρπῶν στόματος ψυχὴ ἀνδρὸς πλησθήσεται ἀγαθῶν, ἀνταπόδομα δὲ χειλέων αὐτοῦ δοθήσεται αὐτῷ.
vulg: de fructu oris sui unusquisque replebitur bonis et iuxta opera manuum suarum retribuetur ei
clem: De fructu oris sui unusquisque replebitur bonis, et juxta opera manuum suarum retribuetur ei.
kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.

wlc: דֶּרֶךְ אֱוִיל יָשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו וְשֹׁמֵעַ לְעֵצָה חָכָם ׃
lxx: ὁδοὶ ἀφρόνων ὀρθαὶ ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν, εἰσακούει δὲ συμβουλίας σοφός.
vulg: via stulti recta in oculis eius qui autem sapiens est audit consilia
clem: Via stulti recta in oculis ejus; qui autem sapiens est audit consilia.
kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

wlc: אֱוִיל בַּיּוֹם יִוָּדַע כַּעְסוֹ וְכֹסֶה קָלוֹן עָרוּם ׃
lxx: ἄφρων αὐθημερὸν ἐξαγγέλλει ὀργὴν αὐτοῦ, κρύπτει δὲ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀτιμίαν πανοῦργος.
vulg: fatuus statim indicat iram suam qui autem dissimulat iniuriam callidus est
clem: Fatuus statim indicat iram suam; qui autem dissimulat injuriam callidus est.
kjv: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.

wlc: יָפִיחַ אֱמוּנָה יַגִּיד צֶדֶק וְעֵד שְׁקָרִים מִרְמָה ׃
lxx: ἐπιδεικνυμένην πίστιν ἀπαγγέλλει δίκαιος, ὁ δὲ μάρτυς τῶν ἀδίκων δόλιος.
vulg: qui quod novit loquitur index iustitiae est qui autem mentitur testis est fraudulentus
clem: Qui quod novit loquitur, index justiti est; qui autem mentitur, testis est fraudulentus.
kjv: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

wlc: יֵשׁ בּוֹטֶה כְּמַדְקְרוֹת חָרֶב וּלְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים מַרְפֵּא ׃
lxx: εἰσὶν οἳ λέγοντες τιτρώσκουσιν μάχαιραι, γλῶσσαι δὲ σοφῶν ἰῶνται.
vulg: est qui promittit et quasi gladio pungitur conscientiae lingua autem sapientium sanitas est
clem: Est qui promittit, et quasi gladio pungitur conscienti: lingua autem sapientium sanitas est.
kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

wlc: שְׂפַת־אֱמֶת תִּכּוֹן לָעַד וְעַד־אַרְגִּיעָה לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר ׃
lxx: χείλη ἀληθινὰ κατορθοῖ μαρτυρίαν, μάρτυς δὲ ταχὺς γλῶσσαν ἔχει ἄδικον.
vulg: labium veritatis firmum erit in perpetuum qui autem testis est repentinus concinnat linguam mendacii
clem: Labium veritatis firmum erit in perpetuum; qui autem testis est repentinus, concinnat linguam mendacii.
kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

wlc: מִרְמָה בְּלֶב־חֹרְשֵׁי רָע וּלְיֹעֲצֵי שָׁלוֹם שִׂמְחָה ׃
lxx: δόλος ἐν καρδίᾳ τεκταινομένου κακά, οἱ δὲ βουλόμενοι εἰρήνην εὐφρανθήσονται.
vulg: dolus in corde cogitantium mala qui autem ineunt pacis consilia sequitur eos gaudium
clem: Dolus in corde cogitantium mala; qui autem pacis ineunt consilia, sequitur eos gaudium.
kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.

wlc: לֹא־יְאֻנֶּה לַצַּדִּיק כָּל־אָוֶן וּרְשָׁעִים מָלְאוּ רָע ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἀρέσει τῷ δικαίῳ οὐδὲν ἄδικον, οἱ δὲ ἀσεβεῖς πλησθήσονται κακῶν.
vulg: non contristabit iustum quicquid ei acciderit impii autem replebuntur malo
clem: Non contristabit justum quidquid ei acciderit: impii autem replebuntur malo.
kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

wlc: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה שִׂפְתֵי־שָׁקֶר וְעֹשֵׂי אֱמוּנָה רְצוֹנוֹ ׃
lxx: βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ χείλη ψευδῆ, ὁ δὲ ποιῶν πίστεις δεκτὸς παρʼ αὐτῷ.
vulg: abominatio Domino labia mendacia qui autem fideliter agunt placent ei
clem: Abominatio est Domino labia mendacia; qui autem fideliter agunt placent ei.
kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.

wlc: אָדָם עָרוּם כֹּסֶה דָּעַת וְלֵב כְּסִילִים יִקְרָא אִוֶּלֶת ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ συνετὸς θρόνος αἰσθήσεως, καρδία δὲ ἀφρόνων συναντήσεται ἀραῖς.
vulg: homo versutus celat scientiam et cor insipientium provocabit stultitiam
clem: Homo versatus celat scientiam, et cor insipientium provocat stultitiam.]
kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

wlc: יַד־חָרוּצִים תִּמְשׁוֹל וּרְמִיָּה תִּהְיֶה לָמַס ׃
lxx: χεὶρ ἐκλεκτῶν κρατήσει εὐχερῶς, δόλιοι δὲ ἔσονται ἐν προνομῇ.
vulg: manus fortium dominabitur quae autem remissa est tributis serviet
clem: [Manus fortium dominabitur; qu autem remissa est, tributis serviet.
kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

wlc: דְּאָגָה בְלֶב־אִישׁ יַשְׁחֶנָּה וְדָבָר טוֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶנָּה ׃
lxx: φοβερὸς λόγος καρδίαν ταράσσει ἀνδρὸς δικαίου, ἀγγελία δὲ ἀγαθὴ εὐφραίνει αὐτόν.
vulg: maeror in corde viri humiliabit illud et sermone bono laetificabitur
clem: Mror in corde viri humiliabit illum, et sermone bono ltificabitur.
kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

wlc: יָתֵר מֵרֵעֵהוּ צַדִּיק וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים תַּתְעֵם ׃
lxx: ἐπιγνώμων δίκαιος ἑαυτοῦ φίλος ἔσται, ἁμαρτάνοντας δὲ καταδιώξεται κακά, ἡ δὲ ὁδὸς τῶν ἀσεβῶν πλανήσει αὐτούς.
vulg: qui neglegit damnum propter amicum iustus est iter autem impiorum decipiet eos
clem: Qui negligit damnum propter amicum, justus est; iter autem impiorum decipiet eos.
kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

wlc: לֹא־יַחֲרֹךְ רְמִיָּה צֵידוֹ וְהוֹן־אָדָם יָקָר חָרוּץ ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἐπιτεύξεται δόλιος θήρας, κτῆμα δὲ τίμιον ἀνὴρ καθαρός.
vulg: non inveniet fraudulentus lucrum et substantia hominis erit auri pretium
clem: Non inveniet fraudulentus lucrum, et substantia hominis erit auri pretium.
kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

wlc: בְּאֹרַח־צְדָקָה חַיִּים וְדֶרֶךְ נְתִיבָה אַל־מָוֶת ׃
lxx: ἐν ὁδοῖς δικαιοσύνης ζωή, ὁδοὶ δὲ μνησικάκων εἰς θάνατον.
vulg: in semita iustitiae vita iter autem devium ducit ad mortem
clem: In semita justiti vita; iter autem devium ducit ad mortem.]
kjv: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.

wlc: בֵּן חָכָם מוּסַר אָב וְלֵץ לֹא־שָׁמַע גְּעָרָה ׃
lxx: Υἱὸς πανοῦργος ὑπήκοος πατρί, υἱὸς δὲ ἀνήκοος ἐν ἀπωλείᾳ.
vulg: filius sapiens doctrina patris qui autem inlusor est non audit cum arguitur
clem: [Filius sapiens doctrina patris; qui autem illusor est non audit cum arguitur.
kjv: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

wlc: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ יֹאכַל טוֹב וְנֶפֶשׁ בֹּגְדִים חָמָס ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ καρπῶν δικαιοσύνης φάγεται ἀγαθός, ψυχαὶ δὲ παρανόμων ὀλοῦνται ἄωροι.
vulg: de fructu oris homo saturabitur bonis anima autem praevaricatorum iniqua
clem: De fructu oris sui homo satiabitur bonis: anima autem prvaricatorum iniqua.
kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

wlc: נֹצֵר פִּיו שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ פֹּשֵׂק שְׂפָתָיו מְחִתָּה־לוֹ ׃
lxx: ὃς φυλάσσει τὸ ἑαυτοῦ στόμα τηρεῖ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν, ὁ δὲ προπετὴς χείλεσιν πτοήσει ἑαυτόν.
vulg: qui custodit os suum custodit animam suam qui autem inconsideratus est ad loquendum sentiet mala
clem: Qui custodit os suum custodit animam suam; qui autem inconsideratus est ad loquendum, sentiet mala.
kjv: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

wlc: מִתְאַוָּה וָאַיִן נַפְשׁוֹ עָצֵל וְנֶפֶשׁ חָרֻצִים תְּדֻשָּׁן ׃
lxx: ἐν ἐπιθυμίαις ἐστιν πᾶς ἀεργός, χεῖρες δὲ ἀνδρείων ἐν ἐπιμελείᾳ.
vulg: vult et non vult piger anima autem operantium inpinguabitur
clem: Vult et non vult piger; anima autem operantium impinguabitur.
kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

wlc: דְּבַר־שֶׁקֶר יִשְׂנָא צַדִּיק וְרָשָׁע יַבְאִישׁ וְיַחְפִּיר ׃
lxx: λόγον ἄδικον μισεῖ δίκαιος, ἀσεβὴς δὲ αἰσχύνεται καὶ οὐχ ἕξει παρρησίαν.
vulg: verbum mendax iustus detestabitur impius confundit et confundetur
clem: Verbum mendax justus detestabitur; impius autem confundit, et confundetur.
kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

wlc: צְדָקָה תִּצֹּר תָּם־דָּרֶךְ וְרִשְׁעָה תְּסַלֵּף חַטָּאת ׃
vulg: iustitia custodit innocentis viam impietas vero peccato subplantat
clem: Justitia custodit innocentis viam, impietas autem peccatorem supplantat.]
kjv: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

wlc: יֵשׁ מִתְעַשֵּׁר וְאֵין כֹּל מִתְרוֹשֵׁשׁ וְהוֹן רָב ׃
lxx: εἰσὶν οἱ πλουτίζοντες ἑαυτοὺς μηδὲν ἔχοντες, καὶ εἰσὶν οἱ ταπεινοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ἐν πολλῷ πλούτῳ.
vulg: est quasi dives cum nihil habeat et est quasi pauper cum in multis divitiis sit
clem: [Est quasi dives, cum nihil habeat, et est quasi pauper, cum in multis divitiis sit.
kjv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.

wlc: כֹּפֶר נֶפֶשׁ־אִישׁ עָשְׁרוֹ וְרָשׁ לֹא־שָׁמַע גְּעָרָה ׃
lxx: λύτρον ἀνδρὸς ψυχῆς ὁ ἴδιος πλοῦτος, πτωχὸς δὲ οὐχ ὑφίσταται ἀπειλήν.
vulg: redemptio animae viri divitiae suae qui autem pauper est increpationem non sustinet
clem: Redemptio anim viri diviti su; qui autem pauper est, increpationem non sustinet.
kjv: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

wlc: אוֹר־צַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמָח וְנֵר רְשָׁעִים יִדְעָךְ ׃
lxx: φῶς δικαίοις διὰ παντός. φῶς δὲ ἀσεβῶν σβέννυται.
vulg: lux iustorum laetificat lucerna autem impiorum extinguetur
clem: Lux justorum ltificat: lucerna autem impiorum extinguetur.
kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

wlc: רַק־בְּזָדוֹן יִתֵּן מַצָּה וְאֶת־נוֹעָצִים חָכְמָה ׃
lxx: κακὸς μεθʼ ὕβρεως πράσσει κακά, οἱ δὲ ἑαυτῶν ἐπιγνώμονες σοφοί.
vulg: inter superbos semper iurgia sunt qui autem agunt cuncta consilio reguntur sapientia
clem: Inter superbos semper jurgia sunt; qui autem agunt omnia cum consilio, reguntur sapientia.
kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

wlc: הוֹן מֵהֶבֶל יִמְעָט וְקֹבֵץ עַל־יָד יַרְבֶּה ׃
lxx: ὕπαρξις ἐπισπουδαζομένη μετὰ ἀνομίας ἐλάσσων γίνεται, ὁ δὲ συνάγων ἑαυτῷ μετʼ εὐσεβείας πληθυνθήσεται· δίκαιος οἰκτείρει καὶ κιχρᾷ.
vulg: substantia festinata minuetur quae autem paulatim colligitur manu multiplicabitur
clem: Substantia festinata minuetur; qu autem paulatim colligitur manu, multiplicabitur.
kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

wlc: תּוֹחֶלֶת מְמֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה־לֵב וְעֵץ חַיִּים תַּאֲוָה בָאָה ׃
lxx: κρείσσων ἐναρχομένοις βοηθῶν καρδίᾳ τοῦ ἐπαγγελλομένου καὶ εἰς ἐλπίδα ἄγοντος· δένδρον γὰρ ζωῆς ἐπιθυμία ἀγαθή.
vulg: spes quae differtur adfligit animam lignum vitae desiderium veniens
clem: Spes qu differtur affligit animam; lignum vit desiderium veniens.]
kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

wlc: בָּז לְדָבָר יֵחָבֶל לוֹ וִירֵא מִצְוָה הוּא יְשֻׁלָּם ׃
lxx: ὃς καταφρονεῖ πράγματος, καταφρονηθήσεται ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ· ὁ δὲ φοβούμενος ἐντολήν, οὗτος ὑγιαίνει.
vulg: qui detrahit alicui rei ipse se in futurum obligat qui autem timet praeceptum in pace versabitur
clem: [Qui detrahit alicui rei, ipse se in futurum obligat; qui autem timet prceptum, in pace versabitur. Anim dolos errant in peccatis: justi autem misericordes sunt, et miserantur.
kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

wlc: תּוֹרַת חָכָם מְקוֹר חַיִּים לָסוּר מִמֹּקְשֵׁי מָוֶת ׃
lxx: νόμος σοφοῦ πηγὴ ζωῆς, ὁ δὲ ἄνους ὑπὸ παγίδος θανεῖται.
vulg: lex sapientis fons vitae ut declinet a ruina mortis
clem: Lex sapientis fons vit, ut declinet a ruina mortis.
kjv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

wlc: שֵׂכֶל־טוֹב יִתֶּן־חֵן וְדֶרֶךְ בֹּגְדִים אֵיתָן ׃
lxx: σύνεσις ἀγαθὴ δίδωσιν χάριν, τὸ δὲ γνῶναι νόμον διανοίας ἐστὶν ἀγαθῆς, ὁδοὶ δὲ καταφρονούντων ἐν ἀπωλείᾳ.
vulg: doctrina bona dabit gratiam in itinere contemptorum vorago
clem: Doctrina bona dabit gratiam; in itinere contemptorum vorago.
kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

wlc: כָּל־עָרוּם יַעֲשֶׂה בְדָעַת וּכְסִיל יִפְרֹשׂ אִוֶּלֶת ׃
lxx: πᾶς πανοῦργος πράσσει μετὰ γνώσεως, ὁ δὲ ἄφρων ἐξεπέτασεν ἑαυτοῦ κακίαν.
vulg: astutus omnia agit cum consilio qui autem fatuus est aperit stultitiam
clem: Astutus omnia agit cum consilio; qui autem fatuus est aperit stultitiam.
kjv: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.

wlc: מַלְאָךְ רָשָׁע יִפֹּל בְּרָע וְצִיר אֱמוּנִים מַרְפֵּא ׃
lxx: βασιλεὺς θρασὺς ἐμπεσεῖται εἰς κακά, ἄγγελος δὲ σοφὸς ῥύσεται αὐτόν.
vulg: nuntius impii cadet in malum legatus fidelis sanitas
clem: Nuntius impii cadet in malum; legatus autem fidelis, sanitas.
kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

wlc: רֵישׁ וְקָלוֹן פּוֹרֵעַ מוּסָר וְשׁוֹמֵר תּוֹכַחַת יְכֻבָּד ׃
lxx: πενίαν καὶ ἀτιμίαν ἀφαιρεῖται παιδεία, ὁ δὲ φυλάσσων ἐλέγχους δοξασθήσεται.
vulg: egestas et ignominia ei qui deserit disciplinam qui autem adquiescit arguenti glorificabitur
clem: Egestas et ignominia ei qui deserit disciplinam; qui autem acquiescit arguenti glorificabitur.
kjv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

wlc: תַּאֲוָה נִהְיָה תֶעֱרַב לְנָפֶשׁ וְתוֹעֲבַת כְּסִילִים סוּר מֵרָע ׃
lxx: ἐπιθυμίαι εὐσεβῶν ἡδύνουσιν ψυχήν, ἔργα δὲ ἀσεβῶν μακρὰν ἀπὸ γνώσεως.
vulg: desiderium si conpleatur delectat animam detestantur stulti eos qui fugiunt mala
clem: Desiderium si compleatur delectat animam; detestantur stulti eos qui fugiunt mala.
kjv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

wlc: הֹלֵוךְ אֶת־חֲכָמִים וֶחְכָּם וְרֹעֶה כְסִילִים יֵרוֹעַ ׃
lxx: συμπορευόμενος σοφοῖς σοφὸς ἔσῃ, ὁ δὲ συμπορευόμενος ἄφροσι γνωσθήσεται.
vulg: qui cum sapientibus graditur sapiens erit amicus stultorum efficietur similis
clem: Qui cum sapientibus graditur sapiens erit; amicus stultorum similis efficietur.]
kjv: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

wlc: חַטָּאִים תְּרַדֵּף רָעָה וְאֶת־צַדִּיקִים יְשַׁלֶּם־טוֹב ׃
lxx: ἁμαρτάνοντας καταδιώξεται κακά, τοὺς δὲ δικαίους καταλήμψεται ἀγαθά.
vulg: peccatores persequetur malum et iustis retribuentur bona
clem: [Peccatores persequitur malum, et justis retribuentur bona.
kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

wlc: טוֹב יַנְחִיל בְּנֵי־בָנִים וְצָפוּן לַצַּדִּיק חֵיל חוֹטֵא ׃
lxx: ἀγαθὸς ἀνὴρ κληρονομήσει υἱοὺς υἱῶν, θησαυρίζεται δὲ δικαίοις πλοῦτος ἀσεβῶν.
vulg: bonus relinquet heredes filios et nepotes et custoditur iusto substantia peccatoris
clem: Bonus reliquit hredes filios et nepotes, et custoditur justo substantia peccatoris.
kjv: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

wlc: רָב־אֹכֶל נִיר רָאשִׁים וְיֵשׁ נִסְפֶּה בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: δίκαιοι ποιήσουσιν ἐν πλούτῳ ἔτη πολλά, ἄδικοι δὲ ἀπολοῦνται συντόμως.
vulg: multi cibi in novalibus patrum et alii congregantur absque iudicio
clem: Multi cibi in novalibus patrum, et aliis congregantur absque judicio.
kjv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

wlc: חוֹשֵׂךְ שִׁבְטוֹ שׂוֹנֵא בְנוֹ וְאֹהֲבוֹ שִׁחֲרוֹ מוּסָר ׃
lxx: ὃς φείδεται τῆς βακτηρίας, μισεῖ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ, ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν ἐπιμελῶς παιδεύει.
vulg: qui parcit virgae suae odit filium suum qui autem diligit illum instanter erudit
clem: Qui parcit virg odit filium suum; qui autem diligit illum instanter erudit.
kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

wlc: צַדִּיק אֹכֵל לְשֹׂבַע נַפְשׁוֹ וּבֶטֶן רְשָׁעִים תֶּחְסָר ׃ פ
lxx: δίκαιος ἔσθων ἐμπιπλᾷ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ, ψυχαὶ δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἐνδεεῖς.
vulg: iustus comedit et replet animam suam venter autem impiorum insaturabilis
clem: Justus comedit et replet animam suam; venter autem impiorum insaturabilis.]
kjv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

wlc: חַכְמוֹת נָשִׁים בָּנְתָה בֵיתָהּ וְאִוֶּלֶת בְּיָדֶיהָ תֶהֶרְסֶנּוּ ׃
lxx: σοφαὶ γυναῖκες ᾠκοδόμησαν οἴκους, ἡ δὲ ἄφρων κατέσκαψεν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῆς.
vulg: sapiens mulier aedificavit domum suam insipiens instructam quoque destruet manibus
clem: [Sapiens mulier dificat domum suam; insipiens exstructam quoque manibus destruet.
kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

wlc: הוֹלֵךְ בְּיָשְׁרוֹ יְרֵא יְהוָה וּנְלוֹז דְּרָכָיו בּוֹזֵהוּ ׃
lxx: ὁ πορευόμενος ὀρθῶς φοβεῖται τὸν κύριον, ὁ δὲ σκολιάζων ταῖς ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ ἀτιμασθήσεται.
vulg: ambulans recto itinere et timens Deum despicitur ab eo qui infami graditur via
clem: Ambulans recto itinere, et timens Deum, despicitur ab eo qui infami graditur via.
kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

wlc: בְּפִי־אֱוִיל חֹטֶר גַּאֲוָה וְשִׂפְתֵי חֲכָמִים תִּשְׁמוּרֵם ׃
lxx: ἐκ στόματος ἀφρόνων βακτηρία ὕβρεως, χείλη δὲ σοφῶν φυλάσσει αὐτούς.
vulg: in ore stulti virga superbiae labia sapientium custodiunt eos
clem: In ore stulti virga superbi; labia autem sapientium custodiunt eos.
kjv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

wlc: בְּאֵין אֲלָפִים אֵבוּס בָּר וְרָב־תְּבוּאוֹת בְּכֹחַ שׁוֹר ׃
lxx: οὗ μή εἰσιν βόες, φάτναι καθαραί· οὗ δὲ πολλὰ γενήματα, φανερὰ βοὸς ἰσχύς.
vulg: ubi non sunt boves praesepe vacuum est ubi autem plurimae segetes ibi manifesta fortitudo bovis
clem: Ubi non sunt boves, prsepe vacuum est; ubi autem plurim segetes, ibi manifesta est fortitudo bovis.
kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

wlc: עֵד אֱמוּנִים לֹא יְכַזֵּב וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים עֵד שָׁקֶר ׃
lxx: μάρτυς πιστὸς οὐ ψεύδεται, ἐκκαίει δὲ ψευδῆ μάρτυς ἄδικος.
vulg: testis fidelis non mentietur profert mendacium testis dolosus
clem: Testis fidelis non mentitur; profert autem mendacium dolosus testis.
kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

wlc: בִּקֶּשׁ־לֵץ חָכְמָה וָאָיִן וְדַעַת לְנָבוֹן נָקָל ׃
lxx: ζητήσεις σοφίαν παρὰ κακοῖς καὶ οὐχ εὑρήσεις, αἴσθησις δὲ παρὰ φρονίμοις εὐχερής.
vulg: quaerit derisor sapientiam et non inveniet doctrina prudentium facilis
clem: Qurit derisor sapientiam, et non invenit; doctrina prudentium facilis.
kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

wlc: לֵךְ מִנֶּגֶד לְאִישׁ כְּסִיל וּבַל־יָדַעְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי־דָעַת ׃
lxx: πάντα ἐναντία ἀνδρὶ ἄφρονι, ὅπλα δὲ αἰσθήσεως χείλη σοφά.
vulg: vade contra virum stultum et nescito labia prudentiae
clem: Vade contra virum stultum, et nescit labia prudenti.
kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

wlc: חָכְמַת עָרוּם הָבִין דַּרְכּוֹ וְאִוֶּלֶת כְּסִילִים מִרְמָה ׃
lxx: σοφία πανούργων ἐπιγνώσεται τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτῶν, ἄνοια δὲ ἀφρόνων ἐν πλάνῃ.
vulg: sapientia callidi est intellegere viam suam et inprudentia stultorum errans
clem: Sapientia callidi est intelligere viam suam, et imprudentia stultorum errans.
kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

wlc: אֱוִלִים יָלִיץ אָשָׁם וּבֵין יְשָׁרִים רָצוֹן ׃
lxx: οἰκίαι παρανόμων ὀφειλήσουσιν καθαρισμόν, οἰκίαι δὲ δικαίων δεκταί.
vulg: stultis inludet peccatum inter iustos morabitur gratia
clem: Stultus illudet peccatum, et inter justos morabitur gratia.
kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

wlc: לֵב יוֹדֵעַ מָרַּת נַפְשׁוֹ וּבְשִׂמְחָתוֹ לֹא־יִתְעָרַב זָר ׃
lxx: καρδία ἀνδρὸς αἰσθητική, λυπηρὰ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ· ὅταν δὲ εὐφραίνηται, οὐκ ἐπιμίγνυται ὕβρει.
vulg: cor quod novit amaritudinem animae suae in gaudio eius non miscebitur extraneus
clem: Cor quod novit amaritudinem anim su, in gaudio ejus non miscebitur extraneus.
kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

wlc: בֵּית רְשָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵד וְאֹהֶל יְשָׁרִים יַפְרִיחַ ׃
lxx: οἰκίαι ἀσεβῶν ἀφανισθήσονται, σκηναὶ δὲ κατορθούντων στήσονται.
vulg: domus impiorum delebitur tabernacula iustorum germinabunt
clem: Domus impiorum delebitur: tabernacula vero justorum germinabunt.
kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

wlc: יֵשׁ דֶּרֶךְ יָשָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ דַּרְכֵי־מָוֶת ׃
lxx: ἔστιν ὁδὸς ἣ δοκεῖ παρὰ ἀνθρώποις ὀρθὴ εἶναι, τὰ δὲ τελευταῖα αὐτῆς ἔρχεται εἰς πυθμένα ᾅδου.
vulg: est via quae videtur homini iusta novissima autem eius deducunt ad mortem
clem: Est via qu videtur homini justa, novissima autem ejus deducunt ad mortem.
kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

wlc: גַּם־בִּשְׂחוֹק יִכְאַב־לֵב וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ שִׂמְחָה תוּגָה ׃
lxx: ἐν εὐφροσύναις οὐ προσμίγνυται λύπη, τελευταία δὲ χαρὰ εἰς πένθος ἔρχεται.
vulg: risus dolore miscebitur et extrema gaudii luctus occupat
clem: Risus dolore miscebitur, et extrema gaudii luctus occupat.
kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

wlc: מִדְּרָכָיו יִשְׂבַּע סוּג לֵב וּמֵעָלָיו אִישׁ טוֹב ׃
lxx: τῶν ἑαυτοῦ ὁδῶν πλησθήσεται θρασυκάρδιος, ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν διανοημάτων αὐτοῦ ἀνὴρ ἀγαθός.
vulg: viis suis replebitur stultus et super eum erit vir bonus
clem: Viis suis replebitur stultus, et super eum erit vir bonus.]
kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

wlc: פֶּתִי יַאֲמִין לְכָל־דָּבָר וְעָרוּם יָבִין לַאֲשֻׁרוֹ ׃
lxx: ἄκακος πιστεύει παντὶ λόγῳ, πανοῦργος δὲ ἔρχεται εἰς μετάνοιαν.
vulg: innocens credit omni verbo astutus considerat gressus suos
clem: [Innocens credit omni verbo; astutus considerat gressus suos. Filio doloso nihil erit boni; servo autem sapienti prosperi erunt actus, et dirigetur via ejus.
kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.

wlc: חָכָם יָרֵא וְסָר מֵרָע וּכְסִיל מִתְעַבֵּר וּבוֹטֵחַ ׃
lxx: σοφὸς φοβηθεὶς ἐξέκλινεν ἀπὸ κακοῦ, ὁ δὲ ἄφρων ἑαυτῷ πεποιθὼς μίγνυται ἀνόμῳ.
vulg: sapiens timet et declinat malum stultus transilit et confidit
clem: Sapiens timet, et declinat a malo; stultus transilit, et confidit.
kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

wlc: קְצַר־אַפַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂה אִוֶּלֶת וְאִישׁ מְזִמּוֹת יִשָּׂנֵא ׃
lxx: ὀξύθυμος πράσσει μετὰ ἀβουλίας, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος πολλὰ ὑποφέρει.
vulg: inpatiens operabitur stultitiam et vir versutus odiosus est
clem: Impatiens operabitur stultitiam, et vir versutus odiosus est.
kjv: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

wlc: נָחֲלוּ פְתָאיִם אִוֶּלֶת וַעֲרוּמִים יַכְתִּרוּ דָעַת ׃
lxx: μεριοῦνται ἄφρονες κακίαν, οἱ δὲ πανοῦργοι κρατήσουσιν αἰσθήσεως.
vulg: possidebunt parvuli stultitiam et astuti expectabunt scientiam
clem: Possidebunt parvuli stultitiam, et exspectabunt astuti scientiam.
kjv: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

wlc: שַׁחוּ רָעִים לִפְנֵי טוֹבִים וּרְשָׁעִים עַל־שַׁעֲרֵי צַדִּיק ׃
lxx: ὀλισθήσουσιν κακοὶ ἔναντι ἀγαθῶν, καὶ ἀσεβεῖς θεραπεύσουσιν θύρας δικαίων.
vulg: iacebunt mali ante bonos et impii ante portas iustorum
clem: Jacebunt mali ante bonos, et impii ante portas justorum.
kjv: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

wlc: גַּם־לְרֵעֵהוּ יִשָּׂנֵא רָשׁ וְאֹהֲבֵי עָשִׁיר רַבִּים ׃
lxx: φίλοι μισήσουσιν φίλους πτωχούς, φίλοι δὲ πλουσίων πολλοί.
vulg: etiam proximo suo pauper odiosus erit amici vero divitum multi
clem: Etiam proximo suo pauper odiosus erit: amici vero divitum multi.
kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.

wlc: בָּז־לְרֵעֵהוּ חוֹטֵא וּמְחוֹנֵן עֲנָיִים אַשְׁרָיו ׃
lxx: ὁ ἀτιμάζων πένητας ἁμαρτάνει, ἐλεῶν δὲ πτωχοὺς μακαριστός.
vulg: qui despicit proximum suum peccat qui autem miseretur pauperi beatus erit
clem: Qui despicit proximum suum peccat; qui autem miseretur pauperis beatus erit. Qui credit in Domino misericordiam diligit.
kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.

wlc: הֲלוֹא־יִתְעוּ חֹרְשֵׁי רָע וְחֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת חֹרְשֵׁי טוֹב ׃
lxx: πλανώμενοι τεκταίνουσι κακά, ἔλεον δὲ καὶ ἀλήθειαν τεκταίνουσιν ἀγαθοί· οὐκ ἐπίστανται ἔλεον καὶ πίστιν τέκτονες κακῶν, ἐλεημοσύναι δὲ καὶ πίστεις παρὰ τέκτοσιν ἀγαθοῖς.
vulg: errant qui operantur malum misericordia et veritas praeparant bona
clem: Errant qui operantur malum; misericordia et veritas prparant bona.
kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

wlc: בְּכָל־עֶצֶב יִהְיֶה מוֹתָר וּדְבַר־שְׂפָתַיִם אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר ׃
lxx: ἐν παντὶ μεριμνῶντι ἔνεστιν περισσόν, ὁ δὲ ἡδὺς καὶ ἀνάλγητος ἐν ἐνδείᾳ ἔσται.
vulg: in omni opere erit abundantia ubi autem verba sunt plurima frequenter egestas
clem: In omni opere erit abundantia; ubi autem verba sunt plurima, ibi frequenter egestas.
kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

wlc: עֲטֶרֶת חֲכָמִים עָשְׁרָם אִוֶּלֶת כְּסִילִים אִוֶּלֶת ׃
lxx: στέφανος σοφῶν πανοῦργος. ἡ δὲ διατριβὴ ἀφρόνων κακή.
vulg: corona sapientium divitiae eorum fatuitas stultorum inprudentia
clem: Corona sapientium diviti eorum; fatuitas stultorum imprudentia.
kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

wlc: מַצִּיל נְפָשׁוֹת עֵד אֱמֶת וְיָפִחַ כְּזָבִים מִרְמָה ׃
lxx: ῥύσεται ἐκ κακῶν ψυχὴν μάρτυς πιστός, ἐκκαίει δὲ ψευδῆ δόλιος.
vulg: liberat animas testis fidelis et profert mendacia versipellis
clem: Liberat animas testis fidelis, et profert mendacia versipellis.]
kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

wlc: בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה מִבְטַח־עֹז וּלְבָנָיו יִהְיֶה מַחְסֶה ׃
lxx: ἐν φόβῳ Κυρίου ἐλπὶς ἰσχύος. τοῖς δὲ τέκνοις αὐτοῦ καταλείπει ἔρεισμα.
vulg: in timore Domini fiducia fortitudinis et filiis eius erit spes
clem: [In timore Domini fiducia fortitudinis, et filiis ejus erit spes.
kjv: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

wlc: יִרְאַת יְהוָה מְקוֹר חַיִּים לָסוּר מִמֹּקְשֵׁי מָוֶת ׃
lxx: πρόσταγμα Κυρίου πηγὴ ζωῆς, ποιεῖ δὲ ἐκκλίνειν ἐκ παγίδος θανάτου.
vulg: timor Domini fons vitae ut declinet a ruina mortis
clem: Timor Domini fons vit, ut declinent a ruina mortis.
kjv: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

wlc: בְּרָב־עָם הַדְרַת־מֶלֶךְ וּבְאֶפֶס לְאֹם מְחִתַּת רָזוֹן ׃
lxx: ἐν πολλῷ ἔθνει δόξα βασιλέως. ἐν δὲ ἐκλείψει λαοῦ συντριβὴ δυνάστου.
vulg: in multitudine populi dignitas regis et in paucitate plebis ignominia principis
clem: In multitudine populi dignitas regis, et in paucitate plebis ignominia principis.
kjv: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

wlc: אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם רַב־תְּבוּנָה וּקְצַר־רוּחַ מֵרִים אִוֶּלֶת ׃
lxx: μακρόθυμος ἀνὴρ πολὺς ἐν φρονήσει, ὁ δὲ ὀλιγόψυχος ἰσχυρὸς ἄφρων.
vulg: qui patiens est multa gubernatur prudentia qui autem inpatiens exaltat stultitiam suam
clem: Qui patiens est multa gubernatur prudentia; qui autem impatiens est exaltat stultitiam suam.
kjv: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

wlc: חַיֵּי בְשָׂרִים לֵב מַרְפֵּא וּרְקַב עֲצָמוֹת קִנְאָה ׃
lxx: πρᾳύθυμος ἀνὴρ καρδίας ἰατρός, σὴς δὲ ὀστέων καρδία αἰσθητική.
vulg: vita carnium sanitas cordis putredo ossuum invidia
clem: Vita carnium sanitas cordis; putredo ossium invidia.
kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

wlc: עֹשֵׁק־דָּל חֵרֵף עֹשֵׂהוּ וּמְכַבְּדוֹ חֹנֵן אֶבְיוֹן ׃
lxx: ὁ συκοφαντῶν πένητα παροξύνει τὸν ποιήσαντα αὐτόν, ὁ δὲ τιμῶν αὐτὸν ἐλεᾷ πτωχόν.
vulg: qui calumniatur egentem exprobrat factori eius honorat autem eum qui miseretur pauperis
clem: Qui calumniatur egentem exprobrat factori ejus; honorat autem eum qui miseretur pauperis.
kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

wlc: בְּרָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶה רָשָׁע וְחֹסֶה בְמוֹתוֹ צַדִּיק ׃
lxx: ἐν κακίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἀπωσθήσεται ἀσεβής, ὁ δὲ πεποιθὼς τῇ ἑαυτοῦ ὁσιότητι δίκαιος.
vulg: in malitia sua expelletur impius sperat autem iustus in morte sua
clem: In malitia sua expelletur impius: sperat autem justus in morte sua.
kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.

wlc: בְּלֵב נָבוֹן תָּנוּחַ חָכְמָה וּבְקֶרֶב כְּסִילִים תִּוָּדֵעַ ׃
lxx: ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀγαθῇ ἀνδρὸς σοφία, ἐν δὲ καρδίᾳ ἀφρόνων οὐ διαγινώσκεται.
vulg: in corde prudentis requiescit sapientia et indoctos quoque erudiet
clem: In corde prudentis requiescit sapientia, et indoctos quosque erudiet.
kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

wlc: צְדָקָה תְרוֹמֵם־גּוֹי וְחֶסֶד לְאֻמִּים חַטָּאת ׃
lxx: δικαιοσύνη ὑψοῖ ἔθνος, ἐλασσονοῦσι δὲ φυλὰς ἁμαρτίαι.
vulg: iustitia elevat gentem miseros facit populos peccatum
clem: Justitia elevat gentem; miseros autem facit populos peccatum.
kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

wlc: רְצוֹן־מֶלֶךְ לְעֶבֶד מַשְׂכִּיל וְעֶבְרָתוֹ תִּהְיֶה מֵבִישׁ ׃
lxx: δεκτὸς βασιλεῖ ὑπηρέτης νοήμων, τῇ δὲ ἑαυτοῦ εὐστροφίᾳ ἀφαιρεῖται ἀτιμίαν.
vulg: acceptus est regi minister intellegens iracundiam eius inutilis sustinebit
clem: Acceptus est regi minister intelligens; iracundiam ejus inutilis sustinebit.]
kjv: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

wlc: מַעֲנֶה־רַּךְ יָשִׁיב חֵמָה וּדְבַר־עֶצֶב יַעֲלֶה־אָף ׃
lxx: ὀργὴ ἀπόλλυσιν καὶ φρονίμους, ἀπόκρισις δὲ ὑποπίπτουσα ἀποστρέφει θυμόν, λόγος δὲ λυπηρὸς ἐγείρει ὀργάς.
vulg: responsio mollis frangit iram sermo durus suscitat furorem
clem: [Responsio mollis frangit iram; sermo durus suscitat furorem.
kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

wlc: לְשׁוֹן חֲכָמִים תֵּיטִיב דָּעַת וּפִי כְסִילִים יַבִּיעַ אִוֶּלֶת ׃
lxx: γλῶσσα σοφῶν καλὰ ἐπίσταται, στόμα δὲ ἀφρόνων ἀναγγελεῖ κακά.
vulg: lingua sapientium ornat scientiam os fatuorum ebullit stultitiam
clem: Lingua sapientium ornat scientiam; os fatuorum ebullit stultitiam.
kjv: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

wlc: בְּכָל־מָקוֹם עֵינֵי יְהוָה צֹפוֹת רָעִים וְטוֹבִים ׃
lxx: ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου· σκοπεύουσιν κακούς τε καὶ ἀγαθούς.
vulg: in omni loco oculi Domini contemplantur malos et bonos
clem: In omni loco, oculi Domini contemplantur bonos et malos.
kjv: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

wlc: מַרְפֵּא לָשׁוֹן עֵץ חַיִּים וְסֶלֶף בָּהּ שֶׁבֶר בְּרוּחַ ׃
