lxx: ἴασις γλώσσης δένδρον ζωῆς, ὁ δὲ συντηρῶν αὐτὴν πλησθήσεται πνεύματος.
vulg: lingua placabilis lignum vitae quae inmoderata est conteret spiritum
clem: Lingua placabilis lignum vit; qu autem immoderata est conteret spiritum.
kjv: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

wlc: אֱוִיל יִנְאַץ מוּסַר אָבִיו וְשֹׁמֵר תּוֹכַחַת יַעְרִם ׃
lxx: ἄφρων μυκτηρίζει παιδίαν πατρός, ὁ δὲ φυλάσσων ἐντολὰς πανουργότερος.
vulg: stultus inridet disciplinam patris sui qui autem custodit increpationes astutior fiet
clem: Stultus irridet disciplinam patris sui; qui autem custodit increpationes astutior fiet. In abundanti justitia virtus maxima est: cogitationes autem impiorum eradicabuntur.
kjv: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

wlc: בֵּית צַדִּיק חֹסֶן רָב וּבִתְבוּאַת רָשָׁע נֶעְכָּרֶת ׃
lxx: ἐν πλεοναζούσῃ δικαιοσύνῃ ἰσχὺς πολλή, οἱ δὲ ἀσεβεῖς ὁλόριζοι ἐκ γῆς ἀπολοῦνται· οἴκοις δικαίων ἰσχὺς πολλή, καρποὶ δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀπολοῦνται.
vulg: domus iusti plurima fortitudo et in fructibus impii conturbatur
clem: Domus justi plurima fortitudo, et in fructibus impii conturbatio.
kjv: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

wlc: שִׂפְתֵי חֲכָמִים יְזָרוּ דָעַת וְלֵב כְּסִילִים לֹא־כֵן ׃
lxx: χείλη σοφῶν δέδεται αἰσθήσει, καρδίαι δὲ ἀφρόνων οὐκ ἀσφαλεῖς.
vulg: labia sapientium disseminabunt scientiam cor stultorum dissimile erit
clem: Labia sapientium disseminabunt scientiam; cor stultorum dissimile erit.
kjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.

wlc: זֶבַח רְשָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה וּתְפִלַּת יְשָׁרִים רְצוֹנוֹ ׃
lxx: θυσίαι ἀσεβῶν βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ, εὐχαὶ δὲ κατευθυνόντων δεκταὶ παρʼ αὐτῷ.
vulg: victimae impiorum abominabiles Domino vota iustorum placabilia
clem: Victim impiorum abominabiles Domino; vota justorum placabilia.
kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

wlc: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ רָשָׁע וּמְרַדֵּף צְדָקָה יֶאֱהָב ׃
lxx: βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ ὁδοὶ ἀσεβοῦς, διώκοντας δὲ δικαιοσύνην ἀγαπᾷ.
vulg: abominatio est Domino via impii qui sequitur iustitiam diligetur ab eo
clem: Abominatio est Domino via impii; qui sequitur justitiam diligitur ab eo.
kjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

wlc: מוּסָר רָע לְעֹזֵב אֹרַח שׂוֹנֵא תוֹכַחַת יָמוּת ׃
lxx: παιδεία ἀκάκου γνωρίζεται ὑπὸ τῶν παριόντων, οἱ δὲ μισοῦντες ἐλέγχους τελευτῶσιν αἰσχρῶς.
vulg: doctrina mala deserenti viam qui increpationes odit morietur
clem: Doctrina mala deserenti viam vit; qui increpationes odit, morietur.
kjv: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.

wlc: שְׁאוֹל וַאֲבַדּוֹן נֶגֶד יְהוָה אַף כִּי־לִבּוֹת בְּנֵי־אָדָם ׃
lxx: ᾅδης καὶ ἀπώλεια φανερὰ παρὰ τῷ κυρίῳ, πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ αἱ καρδίαι τῶν ἀνθρώπων;
vulg: infernus et perditio coram Domino quanto magis corda filiorum hominum
clem: Infernus et perditio coram Domino; quanto magis corda filiorum hominum!
kjv: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

wlc: לֹא יֶאֱהַב־לֵץ הוֹכֵחַ לוֹ אֶל־חֲכָמִים לֹא יֵלֵךְ ׃
lxx: οὐκ ἀγαπήσει ἀπαίδευτος τοὺς ἐλέγχοντας αὐτόν, μετὰ δὲ σοφῶν οὐχ ὁμιλήσει.
vulg: non amat pestilens eum qui se corripit nec ad sapientes graditur
clem: Non amat pestilens eum qui se corripit, nec ad sapientes graditur.]
kjv: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

wlc: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב פָּנִים וּבְעַצְּבַת־לֵב רוּחַ נְכֵאָה ׃
lxx: καρδίας εὐφραινομένης πρόσωπον θάλλει, ἐν δὲ λύπαις οὔσης σκυθρωπάζει.
vulg: cor gaudens exhilarat faciem in maerore animi deicitur spiritus
clem: [Cor gaudens exhilarat faciem; in mrore animi dejicitur spiritus.
kjv: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

wlc: לֵב נָבוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ־דָּעַת וּפְנֵי כְסִילִים יִרְעֶה אִוֶּלֶת ׃
lxx: καρδία ὀρθὴ ζητεῖ αἴσθησιν, στόμα δὲ ἀπαιδεύτων γνώσεται κακά.
vulg: cor sapientis quaerit doctrinam et os stultorum pascetur inperitia
clem: Cor sapientis qurit doctrinam, et os stultorum pascitur imperitia.
kjv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

wlc: כָּל־יְמֵי עָנִי רָעִים וְטוֹב־לֵב מִשְׁתֶּה תָמִיד ׃
lxx: πάντα τὸν χρόνον οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ τῶν κακῶν προσδέχονται κακά, οἱ δὲ ἀγαθοὶ ἡσυχάσουσιν διὰ παντός.
vulg: omnes dies pauperis mali secura mens quasi iuge convivium
clem: Omnes dies pauperis, mali; secura mens quasi juge convivium.
kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

wlc: טוֹב־מְעַט בְּיִרְאַת יְהוָה מֵאוֹצָר רָב וּמְהוּמָה בוֹ ׃
lxx: κρείσσων μικρὰ μερὶς μετὰ φόβου Κυρίου ἢ θησαυροὶ μεγάλοι μετὰ ἀφοβίας.
vulg: melius est parum cum timore Domini quam thesauri magni et insatiabiles
clem: Melius est parum cum timore Domini, quam thesauri magni et insatiabiles.
kjv: Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble therewith.

wlc: טוֹב אֲרֻחַת יָרָק וְאַהֲבָה־שָׁם מִשּׁוֹר אָבוּס וְשִׂנְאָה־בוֹ ׃
lxx: κρείσσων ξενισμὸς μετὰ λαχάνων πρὸς φιλίαν καὶ χάριν ἢ παράθεσις μόσχων μετὰ ἔχθρας.
vulg: melius est vocare ad holera cum caritate quam ad vitulum saginatum cum odio
clem: Melius est vocari ad olera cum caritate, quam ad vitulum saginatum cum odio.
kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

wlc: אִישׁ חֵמָה יְגָרֶה מָדוֹן וְאֶרֶך אַפַּיִם יַשְׁקִיט רִיב ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ θυμώδης παρασκευάζει μάχας, μακρόθυμος δὲ καὶ τὴν μέλλουσαν καταπρᾳύνει·
vulg: vir iracundus provocat rixas qui patiens est mitigat suscitatas
clem: Vir iracundus provocat rixas; qui patiens est mitigat suscitatas.
kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

wlc: דֶּרֶךְ עָצֵל כִּמְשֻׂכַת חָדֶק וְאֹרַח יְשָׁרִים סְלֻלָה ׃
lxx: ὁδοὶ ἀεργῶν ἐστρωμέναι ἀκάνθαις, αἱ δὲ τῶν ἀνδρείων τετριμμέναι.
vulg: iter pigrorum quasi sepes spinarum via iustorum absque offendiculo
clem: Iter pigrorum quasi sepes spinarum; via justorum absque offendiculo.
kjv: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.

wlc: בֵּן חָכָם יְשַׂמַּח־אָב וּכְסִיל אָדָם בּוֹזֶה אִמּוֹ ׃
lxx: υἱὸς σοφὸς εὐφραίνει πατέρα, υἱὸς δὲ ἄφρων μυκτηρίζει μητέρα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: filius sapiens laetificat patrem et stultus homo despicit matrem suam
clem: Filius sapiens ltificat patrem, et stultus homo despicit matrem suam.
kjv: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

wlc: אִוֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָה לַחֲסַר־לֵב וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה יְיַשֶּׁר־לָכֶת ׃
lxx: ἀνοήτου τρίβοι ἐνδεεῖς φρενῶν, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος κατευθύνων πορεύεται.
vulg: stultitia gaudium stulto et vir prudens dirigit gressus
clem: Stultitia gaudium stulto, et vir prudens dirigit gressus suos.
kjv: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

wlc: הָפֵר מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּאֵין סוֹד וּבְרֹב יוֹעֲצִים תָּקוּם ׃
lxx: ὑπερτίθενται λογισμοὺς οἱ μὴ τιμῶντες συνέδρια, ἐν δὲ καρδίαις βουλευομένων μένει βουλή.
vulg: dissipantur cogitationes ubi non est consilium ubi vero plures sunt consiliarii confirmantur
clem: Dissipantur cogitationes ubi non est consilium; ubi vero sunt plures consiliarii, confirmantur.
kjv: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

wlc: שִׂמְחָה לָאִישׁ בְּמַעֲנֵה־פִיו וְדָבָר בְּעִתּוֹ מַה־טּוֹב ׃
lxx: οὐ μὴ ὑπακούσῃ ὁ κακὸς αὐτῇ, οὐδὲ μὴ εἴπῃ καίριόν τι καὶ καλὸν τῷ κοινῷ.
vulg: laetatur homo in sententia oris sui et sermo oportunus est optimus
clem: Ltatur homo in sententia oris sui, et sermo opportunus est optimus.
kjv: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

wlc: אֹרַח חַיִּים לְמַעְלָה לְמַשְׂכִּיל לְמַעַן סוּר מִשְּׁאוֹל מָטָּה ׃
lxx: ὁδοὶ ζωῆς διανοήματα συνετοῦ, ἵνα ἐκκλίνας ἐκ τοῦ ᾅδου σωθῇ.
vulg: semita vitae super eruditum ut declinet de inferno novissimo
clem: Semita vit super eruditum, ut declinet de inferno novissimo.]
kjv: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

wlc: בֵּית גֵּאִים יִסַּח יְהוָה וְיַצֵּב גְּבוּל אַלְמָנָה ׃
lxx: οἴκους ὑβριστῶν κατασπᾷ Κύριος, ἐστήρισεν δὲ ὅριον χήρας.
vulg: domum superborum demolietur Dominus et firmos facit terminos viduae
clem: [Domum superborum demolietur Dominus, et firmos faciet terminos vidu.
kjv: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

wlc: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה מַחְשְׁבוֹת רָע וּטְהֹרִים אִמְרֵי־נֹעַם ׃
lxx: βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ λογισμὸς ἄδικος, ἁγνῶν δὲ ῥήσεις σεμναί.
vulg: abominatio Domini cogitationes malae et purus sermo pulcherrimus
clem: Abominatio Domini cogitationes mal, et purus sermo pulcherrimus firmabitur ab eo.
kjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

wlc: עֹכֵר בֵּיתוֹ בּוֹצֵעַ בָּצַע וְשׂוֹנֵא מַתָּנֹת יִחְיֶה ׃
lxx: ἐξόλλυσιν ἑαυτὸν ὁ δωρολήμπτης, ὁ δὲ μισῶν δώρων λήμψεις σώζεται. (6)ἐλεημοσύναις καὶ πίστεσιν ἀποκαθαίρονται ἁμαρτίαι, τῷ δὲ φόβῳ Κυρίου ἐκκλίνει πᾶς ἀπὸ κακοῦ.
vulg: conturbat domum suam qui sectatur avaritiam qui autem odit munera vivet
clem: Conturbat domum suam qui sectatur avaritiam; qui autem odit munera, vivet. Per misericordiam et fidem purgantur peccata: per timorem autem Domini declinat omnis a malo.
kjv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

wlc: לֵב צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה לַעֲנוֹת וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יַבִּיעַ רָעוֹת ׃
lxx: καρδίαι δικαίων μελετῶσιν πίστεις, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἀποκρίνεται κακά. (7)δεκταὶ παρὰ Κυρίῳ ὁδοὶ ἀνθρώπων δικαίων, διὰ δὲ αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ φίλοι γίνονται.
vulg: mens iusti meditatur oboedientiam os impiorum redundat malis
clem: Mens justi meditatur obedientiam; os impiorum redundat malis.
kjv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

wlc: רָחוֹק יְהוָה מֵרְשָׁעִים וּתְפִלַּת צַדִּיקִים יִשְׁמָע ׃
lxx: μακρὰν ἀπέχει ὁ θεὸς ἀπὸ ἀσεβῶν, εὐχαῖς δὲ δικαίων ἐπακούει. (8)κρείσσων ὀλίγη λῆμψις μετὰ δικαιοσύνης ἢ πολλὰ γενήματα μετὰ ἀδικίας.
vulg: longe est Dominus ab impiis et orationes iustorum exaudiet
clem: Longe est Dominus ab impiis, et orationes justorum exaudiet.
kjv: The Lord is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

wlc: מְאוֹר־עֵינַיִם יְשַׂמַּח־לֵב שְׁמוּעָה טוֹבָה תְּדַשֶּׁן־עָצֶם ׃
vulg: lux oculorum laetificat animam fama bona inpinguat ossa
clem: Lux oculorum ltificat animam; fama bona impinguat ossa.
kjv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.

wlc: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת תּוֹכַחַת חַיִּים בְּקֶרֶב חֲכָמִים תָּלִין ׃
vulg: auris quae audit increpationes vitae in medio sapientium commorabitur
clem: Auris qu audit increpationes vit in medio sapientium commorabitur.
kjv: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

wlc: פּוֹרֵעַ מוּסָר מוֹאֵס נַפְשׁוֹ וְשׁוֹמֵעַ תּוֹכַחַת קוֹנֶה לֵּב ׃
vulg: qui abicit disciplinam despicit animam suam qui adquiescit increpationibus possessor est cordis
clem: Qui abjicit disciplinam despicit animam suam; qui autem acquiescit increpationibus possessor est cordis.
kjv: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

wlc: יִרְאַת יְהוָה מוּסַר חָכְמָה וְלִפְנֵי כָבוֹד עֲנָוָה ׃
vulg: timor Domini disciplina sapientiae et gloriam praecedit humilitas
clem: Timor Domini disciplina sapienti, et gloriam prcedit humilitas.]
kjv: The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.

wlc: לְאָדָם מַעַרְכֵי־לֵב וּמֵיְהוָה מַעֲנֵה לָשׁוֹן ׃
lxx: καρδία δὲ ἀνδρὸς λογιζέσθω δίκαια, ἵνα ὑπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ διορθωθῇ τὰ διαβήματα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: hominis est animum praeparare et Dei gubernare linguam
clem: [Hominis est animam prparare, et Domini gubernare linguam.
kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.

wlc: כָּל־דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ זַךְ בְּעֵינָיו וְתֹכֵן רוּחוֹת יְהוָה ׃
lxx: θεωρῶν ὀφθαλμὸς καλὰ εὐφραίνει καρδίαν, φήμη δὲ ἀγαθὴ πιαίνει ὀστᾶ.
vulg: omnes viae hominum patent oculis eius spirituum ponderator est Dominus
clem: Omnes vi hominis patent oculis ejus; spirituum ponderator est Dominus.
kjv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.

wlc: גֹּל אֶל־יְהוָה מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְיִכֹּנוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ ׃
lxx: ὃς ἀπωθεῖται παιδείαν μισεῖ ἑαυτόν, ὁ δὲ τηρῶν ἐλέγχους ἀγαπᾷ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: revela Domino opera tua et dirigentur cogitationes tuae
clem: Revela Domino opera tua, et dirigentur cogitationes tu.
kjv: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.

wlc: כֹּל פָּעַל יְהוָה לַמַּעֲנֵהוּ וְגַם־רָשָׁע לְיוֹם רָעָה ׃
lxx: φόβος θεοῦ παιδεία καὶ σοφία, καὶ ἀρχὴ δόξης ἀποκριθήσεται αὐτῇ.
vulg: universa propter semet ipsum operatus est Dominus impium quoque ad diem malum
clem: Universa propter semetipsum operatus est Dominus; impium quoque ad diem malum.
kjv: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

wlc: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה כָּל־גְּבַהּ־לֵב יָד לְיָד לֹא יִנָּקֶה ׃
lxx: πάντα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ ταπεινοῦ φανερὰ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ, οἱ δὲ ἀσεβεῖς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακῇ ὀλοῦνται.
vulg: abominatio Domini omnis arrogans etiam si manus ad manum fuerit non erit innocens
clem: Abominatio Domini est omnis arrogans; etiamsi manus ad manum fuerit, non est innocens. Initium vi bon facere justitiam; accepta est autem apud Deum magis quam immolare hostias.
kjv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

wlc: בְּחֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְכֻפַּר עָוֹן וּבְיִרְאַת יְהוָה סוּר מֵרָע ׃
lxx: ἀκάθαρτος παρὰ θεῷ πᾶς ὑψηλοκάρδιος, χειρὶ δὲ χεῖρας ἐμβαλὼν ἀδίκως οὐκ ἀθῳωθήσεται.
vulg: misericordia et veritate redimitur iniquitas et in timore Domini declinatur a malo
clem: Misericordia et veritate redimitur iniquitas, et in timore Domini declinatur a malo.
kjv: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.

wlc: בִּרְצוֹת יְהוָה דַּרְכֵי־אִישׁ גַּם־אוֹיְבָיו יַשְׁלִם אִתּוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀρχὴ ὁδοῦ ἀγαθῆς τὸ ποιεῖν τὰ δίκαια, δεκτὰ δὲ παρὰ θεῷ μᾶλλον ἢ θύειν θυσίας.
vulg: cum placuerint Domino viae hominis inimicos quoque eius convertet ad pacem
clem: Cum placuerint Domino vi hominis, inimicos quoque ejus convertet ad pacem.
kjv: When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

wlc: טוֹב־מְעַט בִּצְדָקָה מֵרֹב תְּבוּאוֹת בְּלֹא מִשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: ὁ ζητῶν τὸν κύριον εὑρήσει γνῶσιν μετὰ δικαιοσύνης, οἱ δὲ ὀρθῶς ζητοῦντες αὐτὸν εὑρήσουσιν εἰρήνην.
vulg: melius est parum cum iustitia quam multi fructus cum iniquitate
clem: Melius est parum cum justitia quam multi fructus cum iniquitate.
kjv: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

wlc: לֵב אָדָם יְחַשֵּׁב דַּרְכּוֹ וַיהוָה יָכִין צַעֲדוֹ ׃
lxx: πάντα τὰ ἔργα τοῦ κυρίου μετὰ δικαιοσύνης, φυλάσσεται δὲ ὁ ἀσεβὴς εἰς ἡμέραν κακήν.
vulg: cor hominis disponet viam suam sed Domini est dirigere gressus eius
clem: Cor hominis disponit viam suam, sed Domini est dirigere gressus ejus.]
kjv: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.

wlc: קֶסֶם עַל־שִׂפְתֵי־מֶלֶךְ בְּמִשְׁפָּט לֹא יִמְעַל־פִּיו ׃
lxx: μαντεῖον ἐπὶ χείλεσιν βασιλέως, ἐν δὲ κρίσει οὐ μὴ πλανηθῇ τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: divinatio in labiis regis in iudicio non errabit os eius
clem: [Divinatio in labiis regis; in judicio non errabit os ejus.
kjv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

wlc: פֶּלֶס וּמֹאזְנֵי מִשְׁפָּט לַיהוָה מַעֲשֵׂהוּ כָּל־אַבְנֵי־כִיס ׃
lxx: ῥοπὴ ζυγοῦ δικαιοσύνη παρὰ Κυρίῳ, τὰ δὲ ἔργα αὐτοῦ στάθμια δίκαια.
vulg: pondus et statera iudicia Domini sunt et opera eius omnes lapides sacculi
clem: Pondus et statera judicia Domini sunt, et opera ejus omnes lapides sacculi.
kjv: A just weight and balance are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work.

wlc: תּוֹעֲבַת מְלָכִים עֲשׂוֹת רֶשַׁע כִּי בִצְדָקָה יִכּוֹן כִּסֵּא ׃
lxx: βδέλυγμα βασιλεῖ ὁ ποιῶν κακά, μετὰ γὰρ δικαιοσύνης ἑτοιμάζεται θρόνος ἀρχῆς.
vulg: abominabiles regi qui agunt impie quoniam iustitia firmatur solium
clem: Abominabiles regi qui agunt impie, quoniam justitia firmatur solium.
kjv: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

wlc: רְצוֹן מְלָכִים שִׂפְתֵי־צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר יְשָׁרִים יֶאֱהָב ׃
lxx: δεκτὰ βασιλεῖ χείλη δίκαια, λόγους δὲ ὀρθοὺς ἀγαπᾷ.
vulg: voluntas regum labia iusta qui recta loquitur diligetur
clem: Voluntas regum labia justa; qui recta loquitur diligetur.
kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

wlc: חֲמַת־מֶלֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי־מָוֶת וְאִישׁ חָכָם יְכַפְּרֶנָּה ׃
lxx: θυμὸς βασιλέως ἄγγελος θανάτου, ἀνὴρ δὲ σοφὸς ἐξιλάσεται αὐτόν.
vulg: indignatio regis nuntii mortis et vir sapiens placabit eam
clem: Indignatio regis nuntii mortis, et vir sapiens placabit eam.
kjv: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

wlc: בְּאוֹר־פְּנֵי־מֶלֶךְ חַיִּים וּרְצוֹנוֹ כְּעָב מַלְקוֹשׁ ׃
lxx: ἐν φωτὶ ζωῆς υἱὸς βασιλέως, οἱ δὲ προσδεκτοὶ αὐτῷ ὥσπερ νέφος ὄψιμον.
vulg: in hilaritate vultus regis vita et clementia eius quasi imber serotinus
clem: In hilaritate vultus regis vita, et clementia ejus quasi imber serotinus.]
kjv: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

wlc: קְנֹה־חָכְמָה מַה־טּוֹב מֵחָרוּץ וּקְנוֹת בִּינָה נִבְחָר מִכָּסֶף ׃
lxx: νοσσιαὶ σοφίας αἱρετώτεραι χρυσίου, νοσσιαὶ δὲ φρονήσεως αἱρετώτεραι ὑπὲρ ἀργύριον
vulg: posside sapientiam quia auro melior est et adquire prudentiam quia pretiosior est argento
clem: [Posside sapientiam, quia auro melior est, et acquire prudentiam, quia pretiosior est argento.
kjv: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

wlc: מְסִלַּת יְשָׁרִים סוּר מֵרָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ נֹצֵר דַּרְכּוֹ ׃
lxx: τρίβοι ζωῆς ἐκκλίνουσιν ἀπὸ κακῶν, μῆκος δὲ βίου ὁδοὶ δικαιοσύνης. ὁ δεχόμενος παιδείαν ἐν ἀγαθοῖς ἔσται, ὁ δὲ φυλάσσων ἐλέγχους σοφισθήσεται. ὃς φυλάσσει τὰς ἑαυτοῦ ὁδοὺς τηρεῖ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν, ἀγαπῶν δὲ ζωὴν αὐτοῦ φείσεται στόματος αὐτοῦ.
vulg: semita iustorum declinat mala custos animae suae servat viam suam
clem: Semita justorum declinat mala; custos anim su servat viam suam.
kjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

wlc: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁבֶר גָּאוֹן וְלִפְנֵי כִשָּׁלוֹן גֹּבַהּ רוּחַ ׃
lxx: πρὸ συντριβῆς ἡγεῖται ὕβρις, πρὸ δὲ πτώματος κακοφροσύνη.
vulg: contritionem praecedit superbia et ante ruinam exaltatur spiritus
clem: Contritionem prcedit superbia, et ante ruinam exaltatur spiritus.
kjv: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

wlc: טוֹב שְׁפַל־רוּחַ אֶת־עֲנִיִּים מֵחַלֵּק שָׁלָל אֶת־גֵּאִים ׃
lxx: κρείσσων πρᾳύθυμος μετὰ ταπεινώσεως ἢ ὃς διαιρεῖται σκῦλα μετὰ ὑβριστῶν.
vulg: melius est humiliari cum mitibus quam dividere spolia cum superbis
clem: Melius est humiliari cum mitibus quam dividere spolia cum superbis.
kjv: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

wlc: מַשְׂכִּיל עַל־דָּבָר יִמְצָא־טוֹב וּבוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה אַשְׁרָיו ׃
lxx: συνετὸς ἐν πράγμασιν εὑρειὴς ἀγαθῶν, πεποιθὼς δὲ ἐπὶ θεῷ μακαριστός.
vulg: eruditus in verbo repperiet bona et qui in Domino sperat beatus est
clem: Eruditus in verbo reperiet bona, et qui sperat in Domino beatus est.
kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.

wlc: לַחֲכַם־לֵב יִקָּרֵא נָבוֹן וּמֶתֶק שְׂפָתַיִם יֹסִיף לֶקַח ׃
lxx: τοὺς σοφοὺς καὶ συνετοὺς φαύλους καλοῦσιν, οἱ δὲ γλυκεῖς ἐν λόγῳ πλείονα ἀκούσονται.
vulg: qui sapiens corde est appellabitur prudens et qui dulcis eloquio maiora percipiet
clem: Qui sapiens est corde appellabitur prudens, et qui dulcis eloquio majora percipiet.
kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

wlc: מְקוֹר חַיִּים שֵׂכֶל בְּעָלָיו וּמוּסַר אֱוִלִים אִוֶּלֶת ׃
lxx: πηγὴ ζωῆς ἔννοια τοῖς κεκτημένοις, παιδεία δὲ ἀφρόνων κακή.
vulg: fons vitae eruditio possidentis doctrina stultorum fatuitas
clem: Fons vit eruditio possidentis; doctrina stultorum fatuitas.]
kjv: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

wlc: לֵב חָכָם יַשְׂכִּיל פִּיהוּ וְעַל־שְׂפָתָיו יֹסִיף לֶקַח ׃
lxx: καρδία σοφοῦ νοήσει τὰ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἰδίου στόματος, ἐπὶ δὲ χείλεσιν φορέσει ἐπιγνωμοσύνην.
vulg: cor sapientis erudiet os eius et labiis illius addet gratiam
clem: [Cor sapientis erudiet os ejus, et labiis ejus addet gratiam.
kjv: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

wlc: צוּף־דְּבַשׁ אִמְרֵי־נֹעַם מָתוֹק לַנֶּפֶשׁ וּמַרְפֵּא לָעָצֶם ׃
lxx: κηρία μέλιτος λόγοι καλοί, γλύκασμα δὲ αὐτοῦ ἴασις ψυχῆς.
vulg: favus mellis verba conposita dulcedo animae et sanitas ossuum
clem: Favus mellis composita verba; dulcedo anim sanitas ossium.
kjv: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

wlc: יֵשׁ דֶּרֶךְ יָשָׁר לִפְנֵי־אִישׁ וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ דַּרְכֵי־מָוֶת ׃
lxx: εἰσὶν ὁδοὶ δοκοῦσαι εἶναι ὀρθαὶ ἀνδρί, τὰ μέντοι τελευταῖα αὐτῶν βλέπει εἰς πυθμένα ᾅδου.
vulg: est via quae videtur homini recta et novissimum eius ducit ad mortem
clem: Est via qu videtur homini recta, et novissima ejus ducunt ad mortem.
kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

wlc: נֶפֶשׁ עָמֵל עָמְלָה לּוֹ כִּי־אָכַף עָלָיו פִּיהוּ ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ ἐν πόνοις πονεῖ ἑαυτῷ καὶ ἐκβιάζεται ἑαυτοῦ τὴν ἀπώλειαν· ὁ μέντοι σκολιὸς ἐπὶ τῷ ἑαυτοῦ στόματι φορεῖ τὴν ἀπώλειαν.
vulg: anima laborantis laborat sibi quia conpulit eum os suum
clem: Anima laborantis laborat sibi, quia compulit eum os suum.
kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

wlc: אִישׁ בְּלִיַּעַל כֹּרֶה רָעָה וְעַל־שְׂפָתָיו כְּאֵשׁ צָרָבֶת ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ ἄφρων ὀρύσσει ἑαυτῷ κακά, ἐπὶ δὲ τῶν ἑαυτοῦ χειλέων θησαυρίζει πῦρ.
vulg: vir impius fodit malum et in labiis eius ignis ardescit
clem: Vir impius fodit malum, et in labiis ejus ignis ardescit.
kjv: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

wlc: אִישׁ תַּהְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּח מָדוֹן וְנִרְגָּן מַפְרִיד אַלּוּף ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ σκολιὸς διαπέμπεται κακά, καὶ λαμπτῆρα δόλου πυρσεύσει κακοῖς, καὶ διαχωρίζει φίλους.
vulg: homo perversus suscitat lites et verbosus separat principes
clem: Homo perversus suscitat lites, et verbosus separat principes.
kjv: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

wlc: אִישׁ חָמָס יְפַתֶּה רֵעֵהוּ וְהוֹלִיכוֹ בְּדֶרֶךְ לֹא־טוֹב ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ παράνομος ἀποπειρᾶται φίλων, καὶ ἀπάγει αὐτοὺς ὁδοὺς οὐκ ἀγαθάς.
vulg: vir iniquus lactat amicum suum et ducit eum per viam non bonam
clem: Vir iniquus lactat amicum suum, et ducit eum per viam non bonam.
kjv: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

wlc: עֹצֶה עֵינָיו לַחְשֹׁב תַּהְפֻּכוֹת קֹרֵץ שְׂפָתָיו כִּלָּה רָעָה ׃
lxx: στηρίζων δὲ ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ διαλογίζεται διεστραμμένα, ὁρίζει δὲ τοῖς χείλεσιν αὐτοῦ πάντα τὰ κακά, οὗτος κάμινός ἐστιν κακίας.
vulg: qui adtonitis oculis cogitat prava mordens labia sua perficit malum
clem: Qui attonitis oculis cogitat prava, mordens labia sua perficit malum.
kjv: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

wlc: עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת שֵׂיבָה בְּדֶרֶךְ צְדָקָה תִּמָּצֵא ׃
lxx: στέφανος καυχήσεως γῆρας, ἐν δὲ ὁδοῖς δικαιοσύνης εὑρίσκεται.
vulg: corona dignitatis senectus in viis iustitiae repperietur
clem: Corona dignitatis senectus, qu in viis justiti reperietur.
kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

wlc: טוֹב אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם מִגִּבּוֹר וּמֹשֵׁל בְּרוּחוֹ מִלֹּכֵד עִיר ׃
lxx: κρείσσων ἀνὴρ μακρόθυμος ἰσχυροῦ, ὁ δὲ κρατῶν ὀργῆς κρείσσων καταλαμβανομένου πόλιν.
vulg: melior est patiens viro forte et qui dominatur animo suo expugnatore urbium
clem: Melior est patiens viro forti, et qui dominatur animo suo expugnatore urbium.
kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

wlc: בַּחֵיק יוּטַל אֶת־הַגּוֹרָל וּמֵיְהוָה כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטוֹ ׃
lxx: εἰς κόλπους ἐπέρχεται πάντα τοῖς ἀδίκοις, παρὰ δὲ Κυρίου πάντα τὰ δίκαια.
vulg: sortes mittuntur in sinu sed a Domino temperantur
clem: Sortes mittuntur in sinum, sed a Domino temperantur.]
kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.

wlc: טוֹב פַּת חֲרֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה־בָהּ מִבַּיִת מָלֵא זִבְחֵי־רִיב ׃
lxx: κρείσσων ψωμὸς μεθʼ ἡδονῆς ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἢ οἶκος πολλῶν ἀγαθῶν καὶ ἀδίκων θυμάτων μετὰ μάχης.
vulg: melior est buccella sicca cum gaudio quam domus plena victimis cum iurgio
clem: [Melior est buccella sicca cum gaudio quam domus plena victimis cum jurgio.
kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

wlc: עֶבֶד־מַשְׂכִּיל יִמְשֹׁל בְּבֵן מֵבִישׁ וּבְתוֹךְ אַחִים יַחֲלֹק נַחֲלָה ׃
lxx: οἰκέτης νοήμων κρατήσει δεσποτῶν ἀφρόνων, ἐν δὲ ἀδελφοῖς διελεῖται μέρη.
vulg: servus sapiens dominabitur filiis stultis et inter fratres hereditatem dividet
clem: Servus sapiens dominabitur filiis stultis, et inter fratres hreditatem dividet.
kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

wlc: מַצְרֵף לַכֶּסֶף וְכוּר לַזָּהָב וּבֹחֵן לִבּוֹת יְהוָה ׃
lxx: ὥσπερ δοκιμάζεται ἐν καμίνῳ ἄργυρος καὶ χρυσός, οὕτως ἐκλεκταὶ καρδίαι παρὰ Κυρίῳ.
vulg: sicut igne probatur argentum et aurum camino ita corda probat Dominus
clem: Sicut igne probatur argentum et aurum camino, ita corda probat Dominus.
kjv: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts.

wlc: מֵרַע מַקְשִׁיב עַל־שְׂפַת־אָוֶן שֶׁקֶר מֵזִין עַל־לְשׁוֹן הַוֹּת ׃
lxx: κακὸς ὑπακούει γλώσσης παρανόμων, δίκαιος δὲ οὐ προσέχει χείλεσιν ψευδέσιν.
vulg: malus oboedit linguae iniquae et fallax obtemperat labiis mendacibus
clem: Malus obedit lingu iniqu, et fallax obtemperat labiis mendacibus.
kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

wlc: לֹעֵג לָרָשׁ חֵרֵף עֹשֵׂהוּ שָׂמֵחַ לְאֵיד לֹא יִנָּקֶה ׃
lxx: ὁ καταγελῶν πτωχοῦ παροξύνει τὸν ποιήσαντα αὐτόν, ὁ δὲ ἐπιχαίρων ἀπολλυμένῳ οὐκ ἀθῳωθήσεται· ὁ δὲ ἐπισπλαχνιζόμενος ἐλεηθήσεται.
vulg: qui despicit pauperem exprobrat factori eius et qui in ruina laetatur alterius non erit inpunitus
clem: Qui despicit pauperem exprobrat factori ejus, et qui ruina ltatur alterius non erit impunitus.
kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

wlc: עֲטֶרֶת זְקֵנִים בְּנֵי בָנִים וְתִפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים אֲבוֹתָם ׃
lxx: στέφανος γερόντων τέκνα τέκνων, καύχημα δὲ τέκνων πατέρες αὐτῶν.
vulg: corona senum filii filiorum et gloria filiorum patres sui
clem: Corona senum filii filiorum, et gloria filiorum patres eorum.
kjv: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

wlc: לֹא־נָאוָה לְנָבָל שְׂפַת־יֶתֶר אַף כִּי־לְנָדִיב שְׂפַת־שָׁקֶר ׃
lxx: οὐχ ἁρμόσει ἄφρονι χείλη πιστά, οὐδὲ δικαίῳ χείλη ψευδῆ.
vulg: non decent stultum verba conposita nec principem labium mentiens
clem: Non decent stultum verba composita, nec principem labium mentiens.
kjv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

wlc: אֶבֶן־חֵן הַשֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵי בְעָלָיו אֶל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יִפְנֶה יַשְׂכִּיל ׃
lxx: μισθὸς χαρίτων παιδεία τοῖς χρωμένοις, οὗ δ᾿ ἂν ἐπιστρέψῃ, εὐοδωθήσεται.
vulg: gemma gratissima expectatio praestolantis quocumque se verterit prudenter intellegit
clem: Gemma gratissima exspectatio prstolantis; quocumque se vertit, prudenter intelligit.
kjv: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

wlc: מְכַסֶּה־פֶּשַׁע מְבַקֵּשׁ אַהֲבָה וְשֹׁנֶה בְדָבָר מַפְרִיד אַלּוּף ׃
lxx: ὃς κρύπτει ἀδικήματα ζητεῖ φιλίαν, ὃς δὲ μισεῖ κρύπτειν διίστησιν φίλους καὶ οἰκείους.
vulg: qui celat delictum quaerit amicitias qui altero sermone repetit separat foederatos
clem: Qui celat delictum qurit amicitias; qui altero sermone repetit, separat fderatos.
kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

wlc: תֵּחַת גְּעָרָה בְמֵבִין מֵהַכּוֹת כְּסִיל מֵאָה ׃
lxx: συντρίβει ἀπειλὴ καρδίαν φρονίμου, ἄφρων δὲ μαστιγωθεὶς οὐκ αἰσθάνεται.
vulg: plus proficit correptio apud prudentem quam centum plagae apud stultum
clem: Plus proficit correptio apud prudentem, quam centum plag apud stultum.
kjv: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

wlc: אַךְ־מְרִי יְבַקֶּשׁ־רָע וּמַלְאָךְ אַכְזָרִי יְשֻׁלַּח־בּוֹ ׃
lxx: ἀντιλογίας ἐγείρει πᾶς κακός, ὁ δὲ Κύριος ἄγγελον ἀνελεήμονα ἐκπέμψει αὐτῷ.
vulg: semper iurgia quaerit malus angelus autem crudelis mittetur contra eum
clem: Semper jurgia qurit malus: angelus autem crudelis mittetur contra eum.
kjv: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

wlc: פָּגוֹשׁ דֹּב שַׁכּוּל בְּאִישׁ וְאַל־כְּסִיל בְּאִוַּלְתּוֹ ׃
lxx: ἐμπεσεῖται μέριμνα ἀνδρὶ νοήμονι, οἱ δὲ ἄφρονες διαλογιοῦνται κακά.
vulg: expedit magis ursae occurrere raptis fetibus quam fatuo confidenti sibi in stultitia sua
clem: Expedit magis urs occurrere raptis ftibus, quam fatuo confidenti in stultitia sua.
kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

wlc: מֵשִׁיב רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה לֹא־תָמִישׁ רָעָה מִבֵּיתוֹ ׃
lxx: ὃς ἀποδίδωσιν κακὰ ἀντὶ ἀγαθῶν, οὐ κινηθήσεται κακὰ ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ.
vulg: qui reddit mala pro bonis non recedet malum de domo eius
clem: Qui reddit mala pro bonis, non recedet malum de domo ejus.
kjv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

wlc: פּוֹטֵר מַיִם רֵאשִׁית מָדוֹן וְלִפְנֵי הִתְגַּלַּע הָרִיב נְטוֹשׁ ׃
lxx: ἐξουσίαν δίδωσιν λόγοις ἀρχὴ δικαιοσύνης, προηγεῖται δὲ τῆς ἐνδείας στάσις καὶ μάχη.
vulg: qui dimittit aquam caput est iurgiorum et antequam patiatur contumeliam iudicium deserit
clem: Qui dimittit aquam caput est jurgiorum, et antequam patiatur contumeliam judicium deserit.]
kjv: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

wlc: מַצְדִּיק רָשָׁע וּמַרְשִׁיעַ צַדִּיק תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: ὃς δίκαιον κρίνει τὸν ἄδικον, ἄδικον δὲ τὸν δίκαιον, ἀκάθαρτος καὶ βδελυκτὸς παρὰ θεῷ.
vulg: et qui iustificat impium et qui condemnat iustum abominabilis est uterque apud Dominum
clem: [Qui justificat impium, et qui condemnat justum, abominabilis est uterque apud Deum.
kjv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord.

wlc: לָמָּה־זֶּה מְחִיר בְּיַד־כְּסִיל לִקְנוֹת חָכְמָה וְלֶב־אָיִן ׃
lxx: ἵνα τί ὑπῆρξεν χρήματα ἄφρονι; κτήσασθαι γὰρ σοφίαν ἀκάρδιος οὐ δυνήσεται. (19)ὃς ὑψηλὸν ποιεῖ τὸν ἑαυτοῦ οἶκον ζητεῖ συντριβήν, (20)ὁ δὲ σκολιάζων τοῦ μαθεῖν ἐμπεσεῖται εἰς κακά.
vulg: quid prodest habere divitias stultum cum sapientiam emere non possit
clem: Quid prodest stulto habere divitias, cum sapientiam emere non possit? Qui altum facit domum suam qurit ruinam, et qui evitat discere incidet in mala.
kjv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?

wlc: בְּכָל־עֵת אֹהֵב הָרֵעַ וְאָח לְצָרָה יִוָּלֵד ׃
lxx: εἰς πάντα καιρὸν φίλος ὑπαρχέτω σοι, ἀδελφοὶ δὲ ἐν ἀνάγκαις χρήσιμοι ἔστωσαν, τούτου γὰρ χάριν γεννῶνται.
vulg: omni tempore diligit qui amicus est et frater in angustiis conprobatur
clem: Omni tempore diligit qui amicus est, et frater in angustiis comprobatur.
kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

wlc: אָדָם חֲסַר־לֵב תּוֹקֵעַ כָּף עֹרֵב עֲרֻבָּה לִפְנֵי רֵעֵהוּ ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ ἄφρων ἐπικροτεῖ καὶ ἐπιχαίρει ἑαυτῷ, ὡς καὶ ὁ ἐγγυώμενος ἐγγύην τῶν ἑαυτοῦ φίλων.
vulg: homo stultus plaudet manibus cum spoponderit pro amico suo
clem: Stultus homo plaudet manibus, cum spoponderit pro amico suo.
kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

wlc: אֹהֵב פֶּשַׁע אֹהֵב מַצָּה מַגְבִּיהַּ פִּתְחוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־שָׁבֶר ׃
lxx: φιλαμαρτήμων χαίρει μάχαις,
vulg: qui meditatur discordiam diligit rixas et qui exaltat ostium quaerit ruinam
clem: Qui meditatur discordias diligit rixas, et qui exaltat ostium qurit ruinam.
kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

wlc: עִקֶּשׁ־לֵב לֹא יִמְצָא־טוֹב וְנֶהְפָּךְ בִּלְשׁוֹנוֹ יִפּוֹל בְּרָעָה ׃
lxx: ὁ δὲ σκληροκάρδιος οὐ συναντᾷ ἀγαθοῖς. ἀνὴρ εὐμετάβολος γλώσσῃ ἐμπεσεῖται εἰς κακά,
vulg: qui perversi cordis est non inveniet bonum et qui vertit linguam incidet in malum
clem: Qui perversi cordis est non inveniet bonum, et qui vertit linguam incidet in malum.
kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

wlc: יֹלֵד כְּסִיל לְתוּגָה לוֹ וְלֹא־יִשְׂמַח אֲבִי נָבָל ׃
lxx: καρδία δὲ ἄφρονος ὀδύνη τῷ κεκτημένῳ αὐτήν. οὐκ εὐφραίνεται πατὴρ ἐπὶ υἱῷ ἀπαιδεύτῳ, υἱὸς δὲ φρόνιμος εὐφραίνει μητέρα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: natus est stultus in ignominiam suam sed nec pater in fatuo laetabitur
clem: Natus est stultus in ignominiam suam; sed nec pater in fatuo ltabitur.
kjv: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

wlc: לֵב שָׂמֵחַ יֵיטִב גֵּהָה וְרוּחַ נְכֵאָה תְּיַבֶּשׁ־גָּרֶם ׃
lxx: καρδία εὐφραινομένη εὐεκτεῖν ποιεῖ, ἀνδρὸς δὲ λυπηροῦ ξηραίνεται τὰ ὀστᾶ.
vulg: animus gaudens aetatem floridam facit spiritus tristis exsiccat ossa
clem: Animus gaudens tatem floridam facit; spiritus tristis exsiccat ossa.
kjv: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

wlc: שֹׁחַד מֵחֵיק רָשָׁע יִקָּח לְהַטּוֹת אָרְחוֹת מִשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: λαμβάνοντος δῶρα ἐν κόλποις ἀδίκως οὐ κατευοδοῦνται ὁδοί, ἀσεβὴς δὲ ἐκκλίνει ὁδοὺς δικαιοσύνης.
vulg: munera de sinu impius accipit ut pervertat semitas iudicii
clem: Munera de sinu impius accipit, ut pervertat semitas judicii.
kjv: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

wlc: אֶת־פְּנֵי מֵבִין חָכְמָה וְעֵינֵי כְסִיל בִּקְצֵה־אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: πρόσωπον συνετὸν ἀνδρὸς σοφοῦ, οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ τοῦ ἄφρονος ἐπʼ ἄκρα γῆς.
vulg: in facie prudentis lucet sapientia oculi stultorum in finibus terrae
clem: In facie prudentis lucet sapientia; oculi stultorum in finibus terr.
kjv: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

wlc: כַּעַס לְאָבִיו בֵּן כְּסִיל וּמֶמֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּוֹ ׃
lxx: ὀργὴ πατρί ἐστιν υἱὸς ἄφρων, καὶ ὀδύνη τῇ τεκούσῃ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: ira patris filius stultus et dolor matris quae genuit eum
clem: Ira patris filius stultus, et dolor matris qu genuit eum.
kjv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

wlc: גַּם עֲנוֹשׁ לַצַּדִּיק לֹא־טוֹב לְהַכּוֹת נְדִיבִים עַל־יֹשֶׁר ׃
lxx: ζημιοῦν ἄνδρα δίκαιον οὐ καλόν, οὐδὲ ὅσιον ἐπιβουλεύειν δυνάσταις δικαίοις.
vulg: non est bonum damnum inferre iusto nec percutere principem qui recta iudicat
clem: Non est bonum damnum inferre justo, nec percutere principem qui recta judicat.
kjv: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

wlc: חוֹשֵׂךְ אֲמָרָיו יוֹדֵעַ דָּעַת וְקַר־רוּחַ אִישׁ תְּבוּנָה ׃
lxx: ὃς φείδεται ῥῆμα προελέσθαι σκληρὸν ἐπιγνώμων, μακρόθυμος δὲ ἀνὴρ φρόνιμος.
vulg: qui moderatur sermones suos doctus et prudens est et pretiosi spiritus vir eruditus
clem: Qui moderatur sermones suos doctus et prudens est, et pretiosi spiritus vir eruditus.
kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

wlc: גַּם אֱוִיל מַחֲרִישׁ חָכָם יֵחָשֵׁב אֹטֵם שְׂפָתָיו נָבוֹן ׃
lxx: ἀνοήτῳ ἐπερωτήσαντι σοφίαν σοφία λογισθήσεται, ἐνεὸν δέ τις ἑαυτὸν ποιήσας δόξει φρόνιμος εἶναι.
vulg: stultus quoque si tacuerit sapiens putabitur et si conpresserit labia sua intellegens
clem: Stultus quoque, si tacuerit, sapiens reputabitur, et si compresserit labia sua, intelligens.]
kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

wlc: לְתַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּשׁ נִפְרָד בְּכָל־תּוּשִׁיָּה יִתְגַּלָּע ׃
lxx: προφάσεις ζητεῖ ἀνὴρ βουλόμενος χωρίζεσθαι ἀπὸ φίλων, ἐν παντὶ δὲ καιρῷ ἐπονείδιστος ἔσται.
vulg: occasiones quaerit qui vult recedere ab amico omni tempore erit exprobrabilis
clem: [Occasiones qurit qui vult recedere ab amico: omni tempore erit exprobrabilis.
kjv: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

wlc: לֹא־יַחְפֹּץ כְּסִיל בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי אִם־בְּהִתְגַּלּוֹת לִבּוֹ ׃
lxx: οὐ χρείαν ἔχει σοφίας ἐνδεὴς φρενῶν, μᾶλλον γὰρ ἄγεται ἀφροσύνῃ.
vulg: non recipit stultus verba prudentiae nisi ea dixeris quae versantur in corde eius
clem: Non recipit stultus verba prudenti, nisi ea dixeris qu versantur in corde ejus.
kjv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

wlc: בְּבוֹא־רָשָׁע בָּא גַם־בּוּז וְעִם־קָלוֹן חֶרְפָּה ׃
lxx: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἀσεβὴς εἰς βάθος κακῶν, καταφρονεῖ, ἐπέρχεται δὲ αὐτῷ ἀτιμία καὶ ὄνειδος.
vulg: impius cum in profundum venerit peccatorum contemnit sed sequitur eum ignominia et obprobrium
clem: Impius, cum in profundum venerit peccatorum, contemnit; sed sequitur eum ignominia et opprobrium.
kjv: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

wlc: מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים דִּבְרֵי פִי־אִישׁ נַחַל נֹבֵעַ מְקוֹר חָכְמָה ׃
lxx: ὕδωρ βαθὺ λόγος ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀνδρός, ποταμὸς δὲ ἀναπηδύει καὶ πηγὴ ζωῆς.
vulg: aqua profunda verba ex ore viri et torrens redundans fons sapientiae
clem: Aqua profunda verba ex ore viri, et torrens redundans fons sapienti.
kjv: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

wlc: שְׂאֵת פְּנֵי־רָשָׁע לֹא־טוֹב לְהַטּוֹת צַדִּיק בַּמִּשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: θαυμάσαι πρόσωπον ἀσεβοῦς οὐ καλόν, οὐδὲ ὅσιον ἐκκλίνειν τὸ δίκαιον ἐν κρίσει.
vulg: accipere personam impii non est bonum ut declines a veritate iudicii
clem: Accipere personam impii non est bonum, ut declines a veritate judicii.]
kjv: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

wlc: שִׂפְתֵי כְסִיל יָבֹאוּ בְרִיב וּפִיו לְמַהֲלֻמוֹת יִקְרָא ׃
lxx: χείλη ἄφρονος ἄγουσιν αὐτὸν εἰς κακά, τὸ δὲ στόμα αὐτοῦ τὸ θρασὺ θάνατον ἐπικαλεῖται.
vulg: labia stulti inmiscunt se rixis et os eius iurgia provocat
clem: [Labia stulti miscent se rixis, et os ejus jurgia provocat.
kjv: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

wlc: פִּי־כְסִיל מְחִתָּה־לוֹ וּשְׂפָתָיו מוֹקֵשׁ נַפְשׁוֹ ׃
lxx: στόμα ἄφρονος συντριβὴ αὐτῷ, τὰ δὲ χείλη αὐτοῦ παγὶς τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: os stulti contritio eius et labia illius ruina animae eius
clem: Os stulti contritio ejus, et labia ipsius ruina anim ejus.
kjv: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

wlc: דִּבְרֵי נִרְגָּן כְּמִתְלַהֲמִים וְהֵם יָרְדוּ חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן ׃
lxx: ὀκνηροὺς καταβάλλει φόβος, ψυχαὶ δὲ ἀνδρογύνων πεινάσουσιν.
vulg: verba bilinguis quasi simplicia et ipsa perveniunt usque ad interiora ventris
clem: Verba bilinguis quasi simplicia, et ipsa perveniunt usque ad interiora ventris. Pigrum dejicit timor; anim autem effeminatorum esurient.
kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

wlc: גַּם מִתְרַפֶּה בִמְלַאכְתּוֹ אָח הוּא לְבַעַל מַשְׁחִית ׃
lxx: ὁ μὴ ἰώμενος αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ ἀδελφός ἐστιν τοῦ λυμαινομένου ἑαυτόν.
vulg: qui mollis et dissolutus est in opere suo frater est sua opera dissipantis
clem: Qui mollis et dissolutus est in opere suo frater est sua opera dissipantis.
kjv: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

wlc: מִגְדַּל־עֹז שֵׁם יְהוָה בּוֹ־יָרוּץ צַדִּיק וְנִשְׂגָּב ׃
lxx: ἐκ μεγαλωσύνης ἰσχύος ὄνομα Κυρίου, αὐτῷ δὲ προσδραμόντες δίκαιοι ὑψοῦνται.
vulg: turris fortissima nomen Domini ad ipsum currit iustus et exaltabitur
clem: Turris fortissima nomen Domini; ad ipsum currit justus, et exaltabitur.
kjv: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

wlc: הוֹן עָשִׁיר קִרְיַת עֻזּוֹ וּכְחוֹמָה נִשְׂגָּבָה בְּמַשְׂכִּיתוֹ ׃
lxx: ὕπαρξις πλουσίου ἀνδρὸς πόλις ὀχυρά, ἡ δὲ δόξα αὐτῆς μέγα ἐπισκιάζει.
vulg: substantia divitis urbs roboris eius et quasi murus validus circumdans eum
clem: Substantia divitis urbs roboris ejus, et quasi murus validus circumdans eum.
kjv: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

wlc: לִפְנֵי־שֶׁבֶר יִגְבַּהּ לֵב־אִישׁ וְלִפְנֵי כָבוֹד עֲנָוָה ׃
lxx: πρὸ συντριβῆς ὑψοῦται καρδία ἀνδρός, καὶ πρὸ δόξης ταπεινοῦται.
vulg: antequam conteratur exaltatur cor hominis et antequam glorificetur humiliatur
clem: Antequam conteratur, exaltatur cor hominis, et antequam glorificetur, humiliatur.
kjv: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

wlc: מֵשִׁיב דָּבָר בְּטֶרֶם יִשְׁמָע אִוֶּלֶת הִיא־לוֹ וּכְלִמָּה ׃
lxx: ὃς ἀποκρίνεται λόγον πρὶν ἀκοῦσαι, ἀφροσύνη αὐτῷ ἐστιν καὶ ὄνειδος.
vulg: qui prius respondit quam audiat stultum se esse demonstrat et confusione dignum
clem: Qui prius respondet quam audiat, stultum se esse demonstrat, et confusione dignum.
kjv: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.

wlc: רוּחַ־אִישׁ יְכַלְכֵּל מַחֲלֵהוּ וְרוּחַ נְכֵאָה מִי יִשָּׂאֶנָּה ׃
lxx: θυμὸν ἀνδρὸς πρᾳύνει θεράπων φρόνιμος, ὀλιγόψυχον δὲ ἄνδρα τίς ὑποίσει;
vulg: spiritus viri sustentat inbecillitatem suam spiritum vero ad irascendum facilem quis poterit sustinere
clem: Spiritus viri sustentat imbecillitatem suam; spiritum vero ad irascendum facilem quis poterit sustinere?
kjv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

wlc: לֵב נָבוֹן יִקְנֶה־דָּעַת וְאֹזֶן חֲכָמִים תְּבַקֶּשׁ־דָּעַת ׃
lxx: καρδία φρονίμου κτᾶται αἴσθησιν, ὦτα δὲ σοφῶν ζητεῖ ἔννοιαν.
vulg: cor prudens possidebit scientiam et auris sapientium quaerit doctrinam
clem: Cor prudens possidebit scientiam, et auris sapientium qurit doctrinam.]
kjv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

wlc: מַתָּן אָדָם יַרְחִיב לוֹ וְלִפְנֵי גְדֹלִים יַנְחֶנּוּ ׃
lxx: δόμα ἀνθρώπου ἐμπλατύνει αὐτόν, καὶ παρὰ δυνάσταις καθιζάνει αὐτόν.
vulg: donum hominis dilatat viam eius et ante principes spatium ei facit
clem: [Donum hominis dilatat viam ejus, et ante principes spatium ei facit.
kjv: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

wlc: צַדִּיק הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּרִיבוֹ יּבָא־רֵעֵהוּ וַחֲקָרוֹ ׃
lxx: δίκαιος ἑαυτοῦ κατήγορος ἐν πρωτολογίᾳ· ὡς δ᾿ ἂν ἐπιβάλῃ ὁ ἀντίδικος, ἐλέγχεται.
vulg: iustus prior est accusator sui venit amicus eius et investigavit eum
clem: Justus prior est accusator sui: venit amicus ejus, et investigabit eum.
kjv: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

wlc: מִדְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּית הַגּוֹרָל וּבֵין עֲצוּמִים יַפְרִיד ׃
lxx: ἀντιλογίας παύει σιγηρός, ἐν δὲ δυναστείαις ὁρίζει.
vulg: contradictiones conprimit sors et inter potentes quoque diiudicat
clem: Contradictiones comprimit sors, et inter potentes quoque dijudicat.
kjv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

wlc: אָח נִפְשָׁע מִקִּרְיַת־עֹז וּמְדוֹנִים כִּבְרִיחַ אַרְמוֹן ׃
lxx: ἀδελφὸς ὑπὸ ἀδελφοῦ βοηθούμενος ὡς πόλις ὀχυρὰ καὶ ὑψηλή, ἰσχύει δὲ ὥσπερ τεθεμελιωμένον βασίλειον.
vulg: frater qui adiuvatur a fratre quasi civitas firma et iudicia quasi vectes urbium
clem: Frater qui adjuvatur a fratre quasi civitas firma, et judicia quasi vectes urbium.
kjv: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

wlc: מִפְּרִי פִי־אִישׁ תִּשְׂבַּע בִּטְנוֹ תְּבוּאַת שְׂפָתָיו יִשְׂבָּע ׃
lxx: ἀπὸ καρπῶν στόματος ἀνὴρ πίμπλησιν κοιλίαν αὐτοῦ, ἀπὸ δὲ καρπῶν χειλέων αὐτοῦ ἐμπλησθήσεται.
vulg: de fructu oris viri replebitur venter eius et genimina labiorum illius saturabunt eum
clem: De fructu oris viri replebitur venter ejus, et genimina labiorum ipsius saturabunt eum.
kjv: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

wlc: מָוֶת וְחַיִּים בְּיַד־לָשׁוֹן וְאֹהֲבֶיהָ יֹאכַל פִּרְיָהּ ׃
lxx: θάνατος καὶ ζωὴ ἐν χειρὶ γλώσσης, οἱ δὲ κρατοῦντες αὐτῆς ἔδονται τοὺς καρποὺς αὐτῆς.
vulg: mors et vita in manu linguae qui diligunt eam comedent fructus eius
clem: Mors et vita in manu lingu; qui diligunt eam comedent fructus ejus.
kjv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

wlc: מָצָא אִשָּׁה מָצָא טוֹב וַיָּפֶק רָצוֹן מֵיְהוָה ׃
lxx: ὃς εὗρεν γυναῖκα ἀγαθὴν εὗρεν χάριτας, ἔλαβεν δὲ παρὰ θεοῦ ἱλαρότητα·
vulg: qui invenit mulierem invenit bonum et hauriet iucunditatem a Domino
clem: Qui invenit mulierem bonam invenit bonum, et hauriet jucunditatem a Domino. Qui expellit mulierem bonam expellit bonum; qui autem tenet adulteram stultus est et impius.
kjv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the Lord.

wlc: תַּחֲנוּנִים יְדַבֶּר־רָשׁ וְעָשִׁיר יַעֲנֶה עַזּוֹת ׃
lxx: ἀφροσύνη ἀνδρὸς λυμαίνεται τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ, τὸν δὲ θεὸν αἰτιᾶται τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: cum obsecrationibus loquetur pauper et dives effabitur rigide
clem: Cum obsecrationibus loquetur pauper, et dives effabitur rigide.
kjv: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

wlc: אִישׁ רֵעִים לְהִתְרֹעֵעַ וְיֵשׁ אֹהֵב דָּבֵק מֵאָח ׃
vulg: vir amicalis ad societatem magis amicus erit quam frater
clem: Vir amabilis ad societatem magis amicus erit quam frater.]
kjv: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

wlc: טוֹב־רָשׁ הוֹלֵךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ מֵעִקֵּשׁ שְׂפָתָיו וְהוּא כְסִיל ׃
lxx: πλοῦτος προστίθησιν φίλους πολλούς, ὁ δὲ πτωχὸς καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὑπάρχοντος φίλου λείπεται.
vulg: melior est pauper qui ambulat in simplicitate sua quam torquens labia insipiens
clem: [Melior est pauper qui ambulat in simplicitate sua quam dives torquens labia sua, et insipiens.
kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

wlc: גַּם בְּלֹא־דַעַת נֶפֶשׁ לֹא־טוֹב וְאָץ בְּרַגְלַיִם חוֹטֵא ׃
lxx: μάρτυς ψευδὴς οὐκ ἀτιμώρητος ἔσται, ὁ δὲ ἐγκαλῶν ἀδίκως οὐ διαφεύξεται.
vulg: ubi non est scientia animae non est bonum et qui festinus est pedibus offendit
clem: Ubi non est scientia anim, non est bonum, et qui festinus est pedibus offendet.
kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

wlc: אִוֶּלֶת אָדָם תְּסַלֵּף דַּרְכּוֹ וְעַל־יְהוָה יִזְעַף לִבּוֹ ׃
lxx: πολλοὶ θεραπεύουσιν πρόσωπα βασιλέων, πᾶς δὲ ὁ κακὸς γίνεται ὄνειδος ἀνδρί.
vulg: stultitia hominis subplantat gressus eius et contra Deum fervet animo suo
clem: Stultitia hominis supplantat gressus ejus, et contra Deum fervet animo suo.
kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.

wlc: הוֹן יֹסִיף רֵעִים רַבִּים וְדָל מֵרֵעהוּ יִפָּרֵד ׃
lxx: πᾶς ὃς ἀδελφὸν πτωχὸν μισεῖ, καὶ φιλίας μακρὰν ἔσται· ἔννοια ἀγαθὴ τοῖς εἰδόσιν αὐτὴν ἐγγιεῖ, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος εὑρήσει αὐτήν. ὁ πολλὰ κακοποιῶν τελεσιουργεῖ κακίαν, ὃς δὲ ἐρεθίζει λόγους οὐ σωθήσεται.
vulg: divitiae addunt amicos plurimos a paupere autem et hii quos habuit separantur
clem: Diviti addunt amicos plurimos; a paupere autem et hi quos habuit separantur.
kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

wlc: עֵד שְׁקָרִים לֹא יִנָּקֶה וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים לֹא יִמָּלֵט ׃
lxx: ὁ κτώμενος φρόνησιν ἀγαπᾷ ἑαυτόν, ὃς δὲ φυλάσσει φρόνησιν εὑρήσει ἀγαθά.
vulg: testis falsus non erit inpunitus et qui mendacia loquitur non effugiet
clem: Testis falsus non erit impunitus, et qui mendacia loquitur non effugiet.
kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

wlc: רַבִּים יְחַלּוּ פְנֵי־נָדִיב וְכָל־הָרֵעַ לְאִישׁ מַתָּן ׃
lxx: μάρτυς ψευδὴς οὐκ ἀτιμώρητος ἔσται, ͎܎ҏďĎ̠εἰμι ἢ δράκων, ὅτι κατέταξας ἐπʼ ἐμέ φυλ
vulg: multi colunt personam potentis et amici sunt dona tribuenti
clem: Multi colunt personam potentis, et amici sunt dona tribuentis.
kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

wlc: כָּל אֲחֵי־רָשׁ שְׂנֵאֻהוּ אַף כִּי מְרֵעֵהוּ רָחֲקוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְרַדֵּף אֲמָרִים לֹא־הֵמָּה ׃
lxx: οὐ συμφέρει ἄφρονι τρυφή, καὶ ἐὰν οἰκέτης ἄρξηται μεθʼ ὕβρεως δυναστεύειν.
vulg: fratres hominis pauperis oderunt eum insuper et amici procul recesserunt ab eo qui tantum verba sectatur nihil habebit
clem: Fratres hominis pauperis oderunt eum; insuper et amici procul recesserunt ab eo.] [Qui tantum verba sectatur nihil habebit;
kjv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

wlc: קֹנֶה־לֵּב אֹהֵב נַפְשׁוֹ שֹׁמֵר תְּבוּנָה לִמְצֹא־טוֹב ׃
lxx: ἐλεήμων ἀνὴρ μακροθυμεῖ, τὸ δὲ καύχημα αὐτοῦ ἐπέρχεται παρανόμοις.
vulg: qui autem possessor est mentis diligit animam suam et custos prudentiae inveniet bona
clem: qui autem possessor est mentis diligit animam suam, et custos prudenti inveniet bona.
kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

wlc: עֵד שְׁקָרִים לֹא יִנָּקֶה וְיָפִיחַ כְּזָבִים יֹאבֵד ׃ פ
lxx: βασιλέως ἀπειλὴ ὁμοία βρυγμῷ λέοντος, ὥσπερ δὲ δρόσος ἐπὶ χόρτῳ, οὕτως τὸ ἱλαρὸν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: testis falsus non erit inpunitus et qui loquitur mendacia peribit
clem: Falsus testis non erit impunitus, et qui loquitur mendacia peribit.
kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

wlc: לֹא־נָאוֶה לִכְסִיל תַּעֲנוּג אַף כִּי־לְעֶבֶד מְשֹׁל בְּשָׂרִים ׃
lxx: αἰσχύνη πατρὶ υἱὸς ἄφρων· οὐχ ἁγναὶ εὐχαὶ ἀπὸ μισθώματος ἑταίρας.
vulg: non decent stultum deliciae nec servum dominari principibus
clem: Non decent stultum delici, nec servum dominari principibus.
kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

wlc: שֵׂכֶל אָדָם הֶאֱרִיךְ אַפּוֹ וְתִפאַרְתּוֹ עֲבֹר עַל־פָּשַׁע ׃
lxx: οἶκον καὶ ὕπαρξιν μερίζουσιν πατέρες παισίν, παρὰ δὲ θεοῦ ἁρμόζεται γυνὴ ἀνδρί.
vulg: doctrina viri per patientiam noscitur et gloria eius est iniqua praetergredi
clem: Doctrina viri per patientiam noscitur, et gloria ejus est iniqua prtergredi.
kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

wlc: נַהַם כַּכְּפִיר זַעַף מֶלֶךְ וּכְטַל עַל־עֵשֶׂב רְצוֹנוֹ ׃
lxx: δειλία κατέχει ἀνδρογύναιον, ψυχὴ δὲ ἀεργοῦ πεινάσει.
vulg: sicut fremitus leonis ita et regis ira et sicut ros super herbam ita hilaritas eius
clem: Sicut fremitus leonis, ita et regis ira, et sicut ros super herbam, ita et hilaritas ejus.
kjv: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

wlc: הַוֹּת לְאָבִיו בֵּן כְּסִיל וְדֶלֶף טֹרֵד מִדְיְנֵי אִשָּׁה ׃
lxx: ὃς φυλάσσει ἐντολὴν τηρεῖ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν, ὁ δὲ καταφρονῶν τῶν ἑαυτοῦ ὁδῶν ἀπολεῖται.
vulg: dolor patris filius stultus et tecta iugiter perstillantia litigiosa mulier
clem: Dolor patris filius stultus, et tecta jugiter perstillantia litigiosa mulier.
kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

wlc: בַּיִת וָהוֹן נַחֲלַת אָבוֹת וּמֵיְהוָה אִשָּׁה מַשְׂכָּלֶת ׃
lxx: δανίζει θεῷ ὁ ἐλεῶν πτωχόν, κατὰ δὲ τὸ δόμα αὐτοῦ ἀνταποδοθήσεται αὐτῷ.
vulg: domus et divitiae dantur a patribus a Domino autem proprie uxor prudens
clem: Domus et diviti dantur a parentibus; a Domino autem proprie uxor prudens.
kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.

wlc: עַצְלָה תַּפִּיל תַּרְדֵּמָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְמִיָּה תִרְעָב ׃
lxx: παίδευε υἱόν σου, οὕτως γὰρ ἔσται εὔελπις, εἰς δὲ ὕβριν μὴ ἐπαίρου τῇ ψυχῇ σου.
vulg: pigredo inmittit soporem et anima dissoluta esuriet
clem: Pigredo immittit soporem, et anima dissoluta esuriet.
kjv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

wlc: שֹׁמֵר מִצְוָה שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹ בּוֹזֵה דְרָכָיו יוּמָת ׃
lxx: κακόφρων ἀνὴρ ζημιωθήσεται· ἐὰν δὲ λοιμεύηται, καὶ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ προσθήσει.
vulg: qui custodit mandatum custodit animam suam qui autem neglegit vias suas mortificabitur
clem: Qui custodit mandatum custodit animam suam; qui autem negligit viam suam mortificabitur.
kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

wlc: מַלְוֵה יְהוָה חוֹנֵן דָּל וּגְמֻלוֹ יְשַׁלֶּם־לוֹ ׃
lxx: Ἄκουε, υἱέ, παιδείαν πατρός σου, ἵνα σοφὸς γένῃ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων σου.
vulg: feneratur Domino qui miseretur pauperis et vicissitudinem suam reddet ei
clem: Fneratur Domino qui miseretur pauperis, et vicissitudinem suam reddet ei.
kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

wlc: יַסֵּר בִּנְךָ כִּי־יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה וְאֶל־הֲמִיתוֹ אַל־תִּשָּׂא נַפְשֶׁךָ ׃
lxx: πολλοὶ λογισμοὶ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀνδρός, ἡ δὲ βουλὴ τοῦ κυρίου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μένει.
vulg: erudi filium tuum ne desperes ad interfectionem autem eius ne ponas animam tuam
clem: Erudi filium tuum; ne desperes: ad interfectionem autem ejus ne ponas animam tuam.
kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

wlc: גְּרָל־חֵמָה נֹשֵׂא עֹנֶשׁ כִּי אִם־תַּצִּיל וְעוֹד תּוֹסִף ׃
lxx: καρπὸς ἀνδρὶ ἐλεημοσύνη, κρείσσων δὲ πτωχὸς δίκαιος ἢ πλούσιος ψευδής.
vulg: qui inpatiens est sustinebit damnum et cum rapuerit aliud adponet
clem: Qui impatiens est sustinebit damnum, et cum rapuerit, aliud apponet.
kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

wlc: שְׁמַע עֵצָה וְקַבֵּל מוּסָר לְמַעַן תֶּחְכַּם בְּאַחֲרִיתֶךָ ׃
lxx: φόβος Κυρίου εἰς ζωὴν ἀνδρί. ὁ δὲ ἄφοβος αὐλισθήσεται ἐν τόποις οὗ οὐκ ἐπισκοπεῖται γνῶσις.
vulg: audi consilium et suscipe disciplinam ut sis sapiens in novissimis tuis
clem: Audi consilium, et suscipe disciplinam, ut sis sapiens in novissimis tuis.
kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

wlc: רַבּוֹת מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּלֶב־אִישׁ וַעֲצַת יְהוָה הִיא תָקוּם ׃
lxx: ὁ ἐγκρύπτων εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτοῦ χεῖρας ἀδίκως, οὐδὲ τῷ στόματι οὐ μὴ προσενέγκῃ αὐτάς.
vulg: multae cogitationes in corde viri voluntas autem Domini permanebit
clem: Mult cogitationes in corde viri; voluntas autem Domini permanebit.
kjv: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.

wlc: תַּאֲוַת אָדָם חַסְדּוֹ וְטוֹב־רָשׁ מֵאִישׁ כָּזָב ׃
lxx: λοιμοῦ μαστιγουμένου ἄφρων πανουργότερος γίνεται· ἐὰν δὲ ἐλέγχῃς ἄνδρα φρόνιμον, νοήσει αἴσθησιν.
vulg: homo indigens misericors est et melior pauper quam vir mendax
clem: Homo indigens misericors est, et melior est pauper quam vir mendax.
kjv: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

wlc: יִרְאַת יְהוָה לְחַיִּים וְשָׂבֵעַ יָלִין בַּל־יִפָּקֶד רָע ׃
lxx: ὁ ἀτιμάζων πατέρα καὶ ἀπωθούμενος μητέρα αὐτοῦ καταισχυνθήσεται καὶ ἐπονείδιστος ἔσται.
vulg: timor Domini ad vitam et in plenitudine commorabitur absque visitatione pessimi
clem: Timor Domini ad vitam, et in plenitudine commorabitur absque visitatione pessima.]
kjv: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

wlc: טָמַן עָצֵל יָדוֹ בַּצַּלָּחַת גַּם־אֶל־פִּיהוּ לֹא יְשִׁיבֶנָּה ׃
lxx: υἱὸς ἀπολειπόμενος φυλάξαι παιδείαν πατρὸς μελετήσει ῥήσεις κακάς.
vulg: abscondit piger manum suam sub ascella nec ad os suum adplicat eam
clem: [Abscondit piger manum suam sub ascella, nec ad os suum applicat eam.
kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

wlc: לֵץ תַּכֶּה וּפֶתִי יַעְרִם וְהוֹכִיחַ לְנָבוֹן יָבִין דָּעַת ׃
lxx: ὁ ἐγγυώμενος παῖδα ἄφρονα καθυβρίζει δικαίωμα, στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν καταπίεται κρίσεις.
vulg: pestilente flagellato stultus sapientior erit sin autem corripueris sapientem intelleget disciplinam
clem: Pestilente flagellato stultus sapientior erit; si autem corripueris sapientem, intelliget disciplinam.
kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

wlc: מְשַׁדֶּד־אָב יַבְרִיחַ אֵם בֵּן מֵבִישׁ וּמַחְפִּיר ׃
lxx: ἑτοιμάζονται ἀκολάστοις μάστιγες, καὶ τιμωρίαι ὁμοίως ἄφροσιν.
vulg: qui adfligit patrem et fugat matrem ignominiosus est et infelix
clem: Qui affligit patrem, et fugat matrem, ignominiosus est et infelix.
kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

wlc: חַדַל־בְּנִי לִשְׁמֹעַ מוּסָר לִשְׁגוֹת מֵאִמְרֵי־דָעַת ׃
vulg: non cesses fili audire doctrinam nec ignores sermones scientiae
clem: Non cesses, fili, audire doctrinam, nec ignores sermones scienti.
kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

wlc: עֵד בְּלִיַּעַל יָלִיץ מִשְׁפָּט וּפִי רְשָׁעִים יְבַלַּע־אָוֶן ׃
vulg: testis iniquus deridet iudicium et os impiorum devorat iniquitatem
clem: Testis iniquus deridet judicium, et os impiorum devorat iniquitatem.
kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

wlc: נָכוֹנוּ לַלֵּצִים שְׁפָטִים וּמַהֲלֻמוֹת לְגֵו כְּסִילִים ׃
vulg: parata sunt derisoribus iudicia et mallei percutientes stultorum corporibus
clem: Parata sunt derisoribus judicia, et mallei percutientes stultorum corporibus.]
kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

wlc: לֵץ הַיַּיִן הֹמֶה שֵׁכָר וְכָל־שֹׁגֶה בּוֹ לֹא יֶחְכָּם ׃
lxx: ἀκόλαστον οἶνος καὶ ὑβριστικὸν μέθη, πᾶς δὲ ἄφρων τοιούτοις συμπλέκεται.
vulg: luxuriosa res vinum et tumultuosa ebrietas quicumque his delectatur non erit sapiens
clem: [Luxuriosa res vinum, et tumultuosa ebrietas: quicumque his delectatur non erit sapiens.
kjv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

wlc: נַהַם כַּכְּפִיר אֵימַת מֶלֶךְ מִתְעַבְּרוֹ חוֹטֵא נַפְשׁוֹ ׃
lxx: οὐ διαφέρει ἀπειλὴ βασλέως θυμοῦ λέοντος, ὁ δὲ παροξύνων αὐτὸν ἁμαρτάνει εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν.
vulg: sicut rugitus leonis ita terror regis qui provocat eum peccat in animam suam
clem: Sicut rugitus leonis, ita et terror regis: qui provocat eum peccat in animam suam.
kjv: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.

wlc: כָּבוֹד לָאִישׁ שֶׁבֶת מֵרִיב וְכָל־אֱוִיל יִתְגַּלָּע ׃
lxx: δόξα ἀνδρὶ ἀποστρέφεσθαι λοιδορίας, πᾶς δὲ ἄφρων τοιούτοις συμπλέκεται.
vulg: honor est homini qui separat se a contentionibus omnes autem stulti miscentur contumeliis
clem: Honor est homini qui separat se a contentionibus; omnes autem stulti miscentur contumeliis.
kjv: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

wlc: מֵחֹרֶף עָצֵל לֹא־יַחֲרֹשׁ יִשְׁאַל בַּקָּצִיר וָאָיִן ׃
lxx: ὀνειδιζόμενος ὀκνηρὸς οὐκ αἰσχύνεται, ὡσαύτως καὶ ὁ δανιζόμενος σῖτον ἐν ἀμήτῳ.
vulg: propter frigus piger arare noluit mendicabit ergo aestate et non dabitur ei
clem: Propter frigus piger arare noluit; mendicabit ergo state, et non dabitur illi.
kjv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

wlc: מַיִם עֲמֻקִּים עֵצָה בְלֶב־אִישׁ וְאִישׁ תְּבוּנָה יִדְלֶנָּה ׃
lxx: ὕδωρ βαθὺ βουλὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀνδρός, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος ἐξαντλήσει αὐτήν.
vulg: sicut aqua profunda sic consilium in corde viri sed homo sapiens exhauriet illud
clem: Sicut aqua profunda, sic consilium in corde viri; sed homo sapiens exhauriet illud.
kjv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

wlc: רָב־אָדָם יִקְרָא אִישׁ חַסְדּוֹ וְאִישׁ אֱמוּנִים מִי יִמְצָא ׃
lxx: μέγα ἄνθρωπος καὶ τίμιον ἀνὴρ ἐλεήμων, ἄνδρα δὲ πιστὸν ἔργον εὑρεῖν.
vulg: multi homines misericordes vocantur virum autem fidelem quis inveniet
clem: Multi homines misericordes vocantur; virum autem fidelem quis inveniet?]
kjv: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

wlc: מִתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתֻמּוֹ צַדִּיק אַשְׁרֵי בָנָיו אַחֲרָיו ׃
lxx: ὃς ἀναστρέφεται ἄμωμος ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ, μακαρίους τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ καταλείψει.
vulg: iustus qui ambulat in simplicitate sua beatos post se filios derelinquet
clem: [Justus qui ambulat in simplicitate sua beatos post se filios derelinquet.
kjv: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

wlc: מֶלֶךְ יוֹשֵׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא־דִין מְזָרֶה בְעֵינָיו כָּל־רָע ׃
lxx: ὅταν βασιλεὺς δίκαιος καθίσῃ ἐπὶ θρόνου, οὐκ ἐναντιοῦται ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ πᾶν πονηρόν.
vulg: rex qui sedet in solio iudicii dissipat omne malum intuitu suo
clem: Rex qui sedet in solio judicii dissipat omne malum intuitu suo.
kjv: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

wlc: מִי־יֹאמַר זִכִּיתִי לִבִּי טָהַרְתִּי מֵחַטָּאתִי ׃
lxx: τίς καυχήσεται ἁγνὴν ἔχειν τὴν καρδίαν; ἢ τίς παρρησιάσεται καθαρὸς εἶναι ἀπὸ ἁμαρτιῶν;
vulg: quis potest dicere mundum est cor meum purus sum a peccato
clem: Quis potest dicere: Mundum est cor meum; purus sum a peccato?
kjv: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

wlc: אֶבֶן וָאֶבֶן אֵיפָה וְאֵיפָה תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: κακολογοῦντος πατέρα ἢ μητέρα σβεσθήσεται λαμπτήρ, αἱ δὲ κόραι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ ὄψονται σκότος.
vulg: pondus et pondus mensura et mensura utrumque abominabile est apud Deum
clem: Pondus et pondus, mensura et mensura: utrumque abominabile est apud Deum.
kjv: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.

wlc: גַּם בְּמַעֲלָלָיו יִתְנַכֶּר־נָעַר אִם־זַךְ וְאִם־יָשָׁר פָּעֳלוֹ ׃
lxx: μερὶς ἐπισπουδαζομένη ἐν πρώτοις ἐν τοῖς τελευταίοις οὐκ εὐλογηθήσεται.
vulg: ex studiis suis intellegitur puer si munda et si recta sint opera eius
clem: Ex studiis suis intelligitur puer, si munda et recta sint opera ejus.
kjv: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

wlc: אֹזֶן שֹׁמַעַת וְעַיִן רֹאָה יְהוָה עָשָׂה גַם־שְׁנֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: μὴ εἴπῃς Τίσομαι τὸν ἐχθρόν· ἀλλὰ ὑπόμεινον τὸν κύριον, ἵνα σοι βοηθήσῃ.
vulg: aurem audientem et oculum videntem Dominus fecit utrumque
clem: Aurem audientem, et oculum videntem: Dominus fecit utrumque.
kjv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the Lord hath made even both of them.

wlc: אַל־תֶּאֱהַב שֵׁנָה פֶּן־תִּוָּרֵשׁ פְּקַח עֵינֶיךָ שְׂבַע־לָחֶם ׃
lxx: στάθμιον μέγα καὶ μικρὸν καὶ μέτρα δισσά, ἀκάθαρτα ἐνώπιον Κυρίου καὶ ἀμφότερα·
vulg: noli diligere somnum ne te egestas opprimat aperi oculos tuos et saturare panibus
clem: Noli diligere somnum, ne te egestas opprimat: aperi oculos tuos, et saturare panibus.
kjv: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

wlc: רַע רַע יֹאמַר הַקּוֹנֶה וְאֹזֵל לוֹ אָז יִתְהַלָּל ׃
lxx: καὶ ὁ ποιῶν αὐτὰ ἐν τοῖς ἐπιτηδεύμασιν αὐτοῦ συνποδισθήσεται, νεανίσκος μετὰ ὁσίου· καὶ εὐθεῖα ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ.
vulg: malum est malum est dicit omnis emptor et cum recesserit tunc gloriabitur
clem: Malum est, malum est, dicit omnis emptor; et cum recesserit, tunc gloriabitur.
kjv: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

wlc: יֵשׁ זָהָב וְרָב־פְּנִינִים וּכְלִי יְקָר שִׂפְתֵי־דָעַת ׃
lxx: οὖς ἀκούει καὶ ὀφθαλμὸς ὁρᾷ· Κυρίου ἔργα καὶ ἀμφότερα,
vulg: est aurum et multitudo gemmarum vas autem pretiosum labia scientiae
clem: Est aurum et multitudo gemmarum, et vas pretiosum labia scienti.]
kjv: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

wlc: לְקַח־בִּגְדוֹ כִּי־עָרַב זָר וּבְעַד נָכְרִים חַבְלֵהוּ ׃
lxx: μὴ ἀγάπα καταλαλεῖν, ἵνα μὴ ἐξαρθῇς· διάνοιξον τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου καὶ ἐμπλήσθητι ἄρτων.
vulg: tolle vestimentum eius qui fideiussor extitit alieni et pro extraneis aufer pignus ab eo
clem: [Tolle vestimentum ejus qui fidejussor extitit alieni, et pro extraneis aufer pignus ab eo.
kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

wlc: עָרֵב לָאִישׁ לֶחֶם שָׁקֶר וְאַחַר יִמָּלֵא־פִיהוּ חָצָץ ׃
lxx: βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ δισσὸν στάθμιον, καὶ ζυγὸς δόλιος οὐ καλὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: suavis est homini panis mendacii et postea implebitur os eius calculo
clem: Suavis est homini panis mendacii, et postea implebitur os ejus calculo.
kjv: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

wlc: מַחֲשָׁבוֹת בְּעֵצָה תִכּוֹן וּבְתַחְבֻּלוֹת עֲשֵׂה מִלְחָמָה ׃
lxx: παρὰ Κυρίου εὐθύνεται τὰ διαβήματα ἀνδρί, θνητὸς δὲ πῶς ἂν νοήσαι τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ;
vulg: cogitationes consiliis roborantur et gubernaculis tractanda sunt bella
clem: Cogitationes consiliis roborantur, et gubernaculis tractanda sunt bella.
kjv: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.

wlc: גּוֹלֶה־סּוֹד הוֹלֵךְ רָכִיל וּלְפֹתֶה שְׂפָתָיו לֹא תִתְעָרָב ׃
lxx: παγὶς ἀνδρὶ ταχύ τι τῶν ἰδίων ἁγιάσαι, μετὰ γὰρ τὸ εὔξασθαι μετανοεῖν γίνεται.
vulg: ei qui revelat mysteria et ambulat fraudulenter et dilatat labia sua ne commiscearis
clem: Ei qui revelat mysteria, et ambulat fraudulenter, et dilatat labia sua, ne commiscearis.
kjv: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.

wlc: מְקַלֵּל אָבִיו וְאִמּוֹ יִדְעַךְ נֵרוֹ בְּאִישׁוֹן חֹשֶׁךְ ׃
lxx: λικμήτωρ ἀσεβῶν βασιλεὺς σοφός, καὶ ἐπιβαλεῖ αὐτοῖς τροχόν.
vulg: qui maledicit patri suo et matri extinguetur lucerna eius in mediis tenebris
clem: Qui maledicit patri suo et matri, extinguetur lucerna ejus in mediis tenebris:
kjv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

wlc: נַחֲלָה מְבֻחֶלֶת בָּרִאשֹׁנָה וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ לֹא תְבֹרָךְ ׃
lxx: φῶς Κυρίου πνοὴ ἀνθρώπων, ὃς ἐραυνᾷ ταμεῖα κοιλίας.
vulg: hereditas ad quam festinatur in principio in novissimo benedictione carebit
clem: hreditas ad quam festinatur in principio, in novissimo benedictione carebit.
kjv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.

wlc: אַל־תֹּאמַר אֲשַׁלְּמָה־רָע קַוֵּה לַיהוָה וְיֹשַׁע לָךְ ׃
lxx: ἐλεημοσύνη καὶ ἀλήθεια φυλακὴ βασιλεῖ, καὶ περικυκλώσουσιν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ τὸν θρόνον αὐτοῦ.
vulg: ne dicas reddam malum expecta Dominum et liberabit te
clem: Ne dicas: Reddam malum: exspecta Dominum, et liberabit te.
kjv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee.

wlc: תּוֹעֲבַת יְהוָה אֶבֶן וָאָבֶן וּמֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה לֹא־טוֹב ׃
lxx: κόσμος νεανίαις σοφία, δόξα δὲ πρεσβυτέρων πολιαί.
vulg: abominatio est apud Deum pondus et pondus statera dolosa non est bona
clem: Abominatio est apud Dominum pondus et pondus; statera dolosa non est bona.
kjv: Divers weights are an abomination unto the Lord; and a false balance is not good.

wlc: מֵיְהוָה מִצְעֲדֵי־גָבֶר וְאָדָם מַה־יָּבִין דַּרְכּוֹ ׃
lxx: ὑπώπια καὶ συντρίμματα συναντᾷ κακοῖς, πληγαὶ δὲ εἰς ταμεῖα κοιλίας.
vulg: a Domino diriguntur gressus viri quis autem hominum intellegere potest viam suam
clem: A Domino diriguntur gressus viri: quis autem hominum intelligere potest viam suam?
kjv: Man's goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?

wlc: מוֹקֵשׁ אָדָם יָלַע קֹדֶשׁ וְאַחַר נְדָרִים לְבַקֵּר ׃
vulg: ruina est hominis devorare sanctos et post vota tractare
clem: Ruina est homini devorare sanctos, et post vota retractare.]
kjv: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.

wlc: מְזָרֶה רְשָׁעִים מֶלֶךְ חָכָם וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אוֹפָן ׃
vulg: dissipat impios rex sapiens et curvat super eos fornicem
clem: [Dissipat impios rex sapiens, et incurvat super eos fornicem.
kjv: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.

wlc: נֵר יְהוָה נִשְׁמַת אָדָם חֹפֵשׂ כָּל־חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן ׃
vulg: lucerna Domini spiraculum hominis quae investigat omnia secreta ventris
clem: Lucerna Domini spiraculum hominis, qu investigat omnia secreta ventris.
kjv: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

wlc: חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ־מֶלֶךְ וְסָעַד בַּחֶסֶד כִּסְאוֹ ׃
vulg: misericordia et veritas custodiunt regem et roboratur clementia thronus eius
clem: Misericordia et veritas custodiunt regem, et roboratur clementia thronus ejus.
kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

wlc: תִּפְאֶרֶת בַּחוּרִים כֹּחָם וַהֲדַר זְקֵנִים שֵׂיבָה ׃
vulg: exultatio iuvenum fortitudo eorum et dignitas senum canities
clem: Exsultatio juvenum fortitudo eorum, et dignitas senum canities.
kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.

wlc: חַבֻּרוֹת פֶּצַע תַּמְרִיק בְּרָע וּמַכּוֹת חַדְרֵי־בָטֶן ׃
vulg: livor vulneris absterget mala et plagae in secretioribus ventris
clem: Livor vulneris absterget mala, et plag in secretioribus ventris.]
kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

wlc: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם לֶב־מֶלֶךְ בְּיַד־יְהוָה עַל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יַחְפֹּץ יַטֶּנּוּ ׃
lxx: ὥσπερ ὁρμὴ ὕδατος, οὕτως καρδία βασιλέως ἐν χειρὶ θεοῦ· οὗ ἐὰν θέλων νεῦσαι, ἐκεῖ ἔκλινεν αὐτήν.
vulg: sicut divisiones aquarum ita cor regis in manu Domini quocumque voluerit inclinabit illud
clem: [Sicut divisiones aquarum, ita cor regis in manu Domini: quocumque voluerit, inclinabit illud.
kjv: The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

wlc: כָּל־דֶּרֶךְ־אִישׁ יָשָׁר בְּעֵינָיו וְתֹכֵן לִבּוֹת יְהוָה ׃
lxx: πᾶς ἀνὴρ φαίνεται ἑαυτῷ δίκαιος, κατευθύνει δὲ καρδίας Κύριος.
vulg: omnis via viri recta sibi videtur adpendit autem corda Dominus
clem: Omnis via viri recta sibi videtur: appendit autem corda Dominus.
kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.

wlc: עֲשֹׂה צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט נִבְחָר לַיהוָה מִזָּבַח ׃
lxx: ποιεῖν δίκαια καὶ ἀληθεύειν ἀρεστὰ παρὰ θεῷ μᾶλλον ἢ θυσιῶν αἷμα.
vulg: facere misericordiam et iudicium magis placent Domino quam victimae
clem: Facere misericordiam et judicium magis placet Domino quam victim.
kjv: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

wlc: רוּם־עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב־לֵב נִר רְשָׁעִים חַטָּאת ׃
lxx: μεγαλόφρων ἐφʼ ὕβρει θρασυκάρδιος· λαμπτὴρ δὲ ἀσεβῶν ἁμαρτία.
vulg: exaltatio oculorum et dilatatio cordis lucerna impiorum peccatum
clem: Exaltatio oculorum est dilatatio cordis; lucerna impiorum peccatum.
kjv: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

wlc: מַחְשְׁבוֹת חָרוּץ אַךְ־לְמוֹתָר וְכָל־אָץ אַךְ־לְמַחְסוֹר ׃
vulg: cogitationes robusti semper in abundantia omnis autem piger semper in egestate
clem: Cogitationes robusti semper in abundantia; omnis autem piger semper in egestate est.]
kjv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

wlc: פֹּעַל אוֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר הֶבֶל נִדָּף מְבַקְשֵׁי־מָוֶת ׃
lxx: ὁ ἐνεργῶν θησαυρίσματα γλώσσῃ ψευδεῖ μάταια διώκει ἐπὶ παγίδας θανάτου.
vulg: qui congregat thesauros lingua mendacii vanus est et inpingetur ad laqueos mortis
clem: [Qui congregat thesauros lingua mendacii vanus et excors est, et impingetur ad laqueos mortis.
kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

wlc: שֹׁד־רְשָׁעִים יְגוֹרֵם כִּי מֵאֲנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט ׃
lxx: ὄλεθρος ἀσεβέσιν ἐπιξενωθήσεται, οὐ γὰρ βούλονται πράσσειν τὰ δίκαια.
vulg: rapinae impiorum detrahent eos quia noluerunt facere iudicium
clem: Rapin impiorum detrahent eos, quia noluerunt facere judicium.
kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

wlc: הֲפַכְפַּךְ דֶּרֶךְ אִישׁ וָזָר וְזַךְ יָשָׁר פָּעֳלוֹ ׃
lxx: πρὸς τοὺς σκολιοὺς σκολιὰς ὁδοὺς ἀποστέλλει ὁ θεός, ἁγνὰ γὰρ καὶ ὀρθὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ.
vulg: perversa via viri aliena est qui autem mundus est rectum opus eius
clem: Perversa via viri aliena est; qui autem mundus est, rectum opus ejus.
kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

wlc: טוֹב לָשֶׁבֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּג מֵאֵשֶׁת מִדְיָנִים וּבֵית חָבֶר ׃
lxx: κρεῖσσον οἰκεῖν ἐπὶ γωνίας ὑπαίθρου ἢ ἐν κεκονιαμένοις μετὰ ἀδικίας καὶ ἐν οἴκῳ κοινῷ.
vulg: melius est sedere in angulo domatis quam cum muliere litigiosa et in domo communi
clem: Melius est sedere in angulo domatis, quam cum muliere litigiosa, et in domo communi.
kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

wlc: נֶפֶשׁ רָשָׁע אִוְּתָה־רָע לֹא־יֻחַן בְּעֵינָיו רֵעֵהוּ ׃
lxx: ψυχὴ ἀσεβοῦς οὐκ ἐλεηθήσεται ὑπʼ οὐδενὸς τῶν ἀνθρώπων.
vulg: anima impii desiderat malum non miserebitur proximo suo
clem: Anima impii desiderat malum: non miserebitur proximo suo.
kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

wlc: בַּעְנָשׁ־לֵץ יֶחְכַּם־פֶּתִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּיל לְחָכָם יִקַּח־דָּעַת ׃
lxx: ζημιουμένου ἀκολάστου πανουργότερος γίνεται ὁ κακός, συνίων δὲ σοφὸς δέξεται γνῶσιν.
vulg: multato pestilente sapientior erit parvulus et si sectetur sapientem sumet scientiam
clem: Mulctato pestilente, sapientior erit parvulus, et si sectetur sapientem, sumet scientiam.
kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

wlc: מַשְׂכִּיל צַדִּיק לְבֵית רָשָׁע מְסַלֵּף רְשָׁעִים לָרָע ׃
lxx: συνίει δίκαιος καρδίας ἀσεβῶν καὶ φαυλίζει ἀσεβεῖς ἐν κακοῖς.
vulg: excogitat iustus de domo impii ut detrahat impios in malum
clem: Excogitat justus de domo impii, ut detrahat impios a malo.]
kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

wlc: אֹטֵם אָזְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּל גַּם־הוּא יִקְרָא וְלֹא יֵעָנֶה ׃
lxx: ὃς φράσσει τὰ ὦτα τοῦ μὴ ἐπακοῦσαι ἀσθενοῦς, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπικαλέσεται καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ εἰσακούων.
vulg: qui obturat aurem suam ad clamorem pauperis et ipse clamabit et non exaudietur
clem: [Qui obturat aurem suam ad clamorem pauperis, et ipse clamabit, et non exaudietur.
kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

wlc: מַתָּן בַּסֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־אָף וְשֹׁחַד בַּחֵק חֵמָה עַזָּה ׃
lxx: δόσις λάθριος ἀνατρέπει ὀργάς, δώρων δὲ ὁ φειδόμενος θυμὸν ἐγείρει ἰσχυρόν.
vulg: munus absconditum extinguet iras et donum in sinu indignationem maximam
clem: Munus absconditum extinguit iras, et donum in sinu indignationem maximam.
kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

wlc: שִׂמְחָה לַצַּדִּיק עֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וּמְחִתָּה לְפֹעֲלֵי אָוֶן ׃
lxx: εὐφροσύνη δικαίων ποιεῖ κρίμα, ὅσιος δὲ ἀκάθαρτος παρὰ κακούργοις.
vulg: gaudium iusto est facere iudicium et pavor operantibus iniquitatem
clem: Gaudium justo est facere judicium, et pavor operantibus iniquitatem.
kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

wlc: אָדָם תּוֹעֶה מִדֶּרֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּל בִּקְהַל רְפָאִים יָנוּחַ ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ πλανώμενος ἐξ ὁδοῦ δικαιοσύνης ἐν συναγωγῇ γιγάντων ἀναπαύσεται.
vulg: vir qui erraverit a via doctrinae in coetu gigantum commorabitur
clem: Vir qui erraverit a via doctrin in ctu gigantum commorabitur.
kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

wlc: אִישׁ מַחְסוֹר אֹהֵב שִׂמְחָה אֹהֵב יַיִן־וָשֶׁמֶן לֹא יַעֲשִׁיר ׃
lxx: ἀνὴρ ἐνδεὴς ἀγαπᾷ εὐφροσύνην, φιλῶν οἶνον καὶ ἔλαιον εἰς πλοῦτον·
vulg: qui diligit epulas in egestate erit qui amat vinum et pinguia non ditabitur
clem: Qui diligit epulas in egestate erit; qui amat vinum et pinguia non ditabitur.
kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

wlc: כֹּפֶר לַצַּדִּיק רָשָׁע וְתַחַת יְשָׁרִים בּוֹגֵד ׃
lxx: περικάθαρμα δὲ δικαίου ἄνομος.
vulg: pro iusto datur impius et pro rectis iniquus
clem: Pro justo datur impius, et pro rectis iniquus.
kjv: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

wlc: טוֹב שֶׁבֶת בְּאֶרֶץ־מִדְבָּר מֵאֵשֶׁת מְדוֹנִים וָכָעַס ׃
lxx: κρεῖσσον οἰκεῖν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἢ μετὰ γυναικὸς γλωσσώδους καὶ μαχίμου καὶ ὀργίλου.
vulg: melius est habitare in terra deserta quam cum muliere rixosa et iracunda
clem: Melius est habitare in terra deserta quam cum muliere rixosa et iracunda.
kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

wlc: אוֹצָר נֶחְמָד וָשֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵה חָכָם וּכְסִיל אָדָם יְבַלְּעֶנּוּ ׃
lxx: θησαυρὸς ἐπιθυμητὸς ἀναπαύσεται ἐπὶ στόματος σοφοῦ, ἄφρονες δὲ ἄνδρες καταπίονται αὐτόν.
vulg: thesaurus desiderabilis et oleum in habitaculo iusti et inprudens homo dissipabit illud
clem: Thesaurus desiderabilis, et oleum in habitaculo justi: et imprudens homo dissipabit illud.
kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

wlc: רֹדֵף צְדָקָה וָחָסֶד יִמְצָא חַיִּים צְדָקָה וְכָבוֹד ׃
lxx: ὁδὸς δικαιοσύνης καὶ ἐλεημοσύνης εὑρήσει ζωὴν καὶ δόξαν.
vulg: qui sequitur iustitiam et misericordiam inveniet vitam et iustitiam et gloriam
clem: Qui sequitur justitiam et misericordiam inveniet vitam, justitiam, et gloriam.
kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

wlc: עִיר גִּבֹּרִים עָלָה חָכָם וַיֹּרֶד עֹז מִבְטֶחָה ׃
lxx: πόλεις ὀχυρὰς ἐπέβη σοφὸς καὶ καθεῖλεν τὸ ὀχύρωμα ἐφʼ ᾧ ἐπεποίθεισαν οἱ ἀσεβεῖς.
vulg: civitatem fortium ascendit sapiens et destruxit robur fiduciae eius
clem: Civitatem fortium ascendit sapiens, et destruxit robur fiduci ejus.
kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

wlc: שֹׁמֵר פִּיו וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ שֹׁמֵר מִצָּרוֹת נַפְשׁוֹ ׃
lxx: ὃς φυλάσσει τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν γλῶσσαν, διατηρεῖ ἐκ θλίψεως τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: qui custodit os suum et linguam suam custodit ab angustiis animam suam
clem: Qui custodit os suum et linguam suam custodit ab angustiis animam suam.
kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

wlc: זֵד יָהִיר לֵץ שְׁמוֹ עוֹשֶׂה בְּעֶבְרַת זָדוֹן ׃
lxx: θρασὺς καὶ αὐθάδης καὶ ἀλαζὼν λοιμὸς καλεῖται, ὃς δὲ μνησικακεῖ παράνομος.
vulg: superbus et arrogans vocatur indoctus qui in ira operatur superbiam
clem: Superbus et arrogans vocatur indoctus, qui in ira operatur superbiam.
kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

wlc: תַּאֲוַת עָצֵל תְּמִיתֶנּוּ כִּי־מֵאֲנוּ יָדָיו לַעֲשׂוֹת ׃
lxx: ἐπιθυμίαι ὀκνηρὸν ἀποκτείνουσιν, οὐ γὰρ προαιροῦνται αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ποιεῖν τι.
vulg: desideria occidunt pigrum noluerunt enim quicquam manus eius operari
clem: Desideria occidunt pigrum: noluerunt enim quidquam manus ejus operari.
kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

wlc: כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִתְאַוָּה תַאֲוָה וְצַדִּיק יִתֵּן וְלֹא יַחְשֹׂךְ ׃
lxx: ἀσεβὴς ἐπιθυμεῖ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ἐπιθυμίας κακάς, ὁ δὲ δίκαιος ἐλεᾷ καὶ οἰκτείρει ἀφειδῶς.
vulg: tota die concupiscit et desiderat qui autem iustus est tribuet et non cessabit
clem: Tota die concupiscit et desiderat; qui autem justus est, tribuet, et non cessabit.
kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

wlc: זֶבַח רְשָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָה אַף כִּי־בְזִמָּה יְבִיאֶנּוּ ׃
lxx: θυσίαι ἀσεβῶν βδέλυγμα Κυρίῳ, καὶ γὰρ παρανόμως προσφέρουσιν αὐτάς.
vulg: hostiae impiorum abominabiles quia offeruntur ex scelere
